raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Sales Enablement Support Manager develops and manages education, resources, and tools that strengthen Commercial readiness across MRO’s clinical data solutions, services, and processes.
raw.description:
Overview

The Sales Enablement Support Manager develops and manages education, resources, and tools that strengthen Commercial readiness across MRO’s clinical data solutions, services, and processes. The role translates complex information into practical, actionable guidance that supports effective client conversations and day-to-day Commercial needs.

This role serves as a critical connection point across executive leadership, Business Development, Partner Success Advisors, Product Marketing, Product Development, Clinical Services, Market Leadership, Legal, Finance and other subject matter experts, translating complex product, clinical, operational, and process information into clear, actionable education for Commercial audiences.

The role requires a highly proactive, self-directed individual who can independently identify enablement needs, investigate complex questions, engage the appropriate stakeholders, and develop practical solutions. Success requires strong healthcare and clinical workflow knowledge, instructional design capabilities, comfort working across multiple business functions, and a high degree of technology fluency.

The Sales Enablement Support Manager is expected to leverage emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve the quality, scalability, and efficiency of enablement efforts.

Responsibilities

Sales Enablement Education & Content Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain education for Commercial teams across product knowledge, clinical services, workflows, processes, positioning, and other enablement needs.
  • Translate complex clinical, technical, product, and operational information into clear, concise, and actionable education appropriate for Sales and Commercial audiences.
  • Develop a variety of enablement resources, including e-learning courses, guides, job aids, presentations, videos, and other learning experiences.
  • Create and maintain live role play trainings and practice experiences that allow team members to apply product knowledge, positioning, discovery, and communication skills in realistic scenarios.
  • Manage Commercial education within the organization's sales enablement and learning platforms, including publishing, organization, maintenance, assignment, and ongoing optimization of educational content.

Enablement Strategy & Needs Identification

  • Proactively identify knowledge, process, and performance gaps that can be addressed through education, resources, technology, or other enablement solutions.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and Commercial stakeholders to understand emerging needs and determine appropriate enablement strategies.
  • Develop scalable resources and programs that reduce recurring knowledge gaps and improve Commercial team self-service.
  • Support onboarding, ongoing development, product launches, process changes, and other initiatives requiring Commercial readiness.

Product, Clinical & Commercial Support

  • Research complex requests and coordinate with appropriate subject matter experts to develop accurate, actionable guidance.
  • Support Sales and pre-sales processes by helping clarify product availability, service capabilities, workflows, and other information required to appropriately position MRO solutions.
  • Identify recurring questions or issues and convert them into reusable education, resources, or process improvements.
  • Maintain a working understanding of MRO's clinical data solutions, service models, workflows, and Commercial processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Marketing, Product Development, Clinical Services, Market Leadership, Sales, Legal, Finance, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure Commercial teams receive accurate and timely information.
  • Support product launches, service changes, process updates, and go-to-market initiatives by identifying Commercial education and readiness requirements.
  • Ensure enablement materials align with approved product positioning, operational capabilities, and organizational strategy.

Technology, AI & Innovation

  • Leverage artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to improve content development, research, workflow efficiency, practice experience, and Sales enablement.
  • Independently evaluate and learn new technology platforms and identify opportunities to apply them to business and enablement challenges.
  • Continuously explore opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve self-service, and increase the scalability and effectiveness of enablement programs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare, education, business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare, clinical services, sales enablement, education, product marketing, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare operations and clinical workflows; experience with clinical data, registries, quality programs, or healthcare data solutions strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information and communicate it clearly, concisely, and appropriately for the intended audience.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively and build relationships across different levels and areas of the organization.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, identify needs, solve ambiguous problems, and move initiatives forward without requiring detailed direction.
  • Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable platforms to improve productivity, develop content, analyze information, automate workflows, or solve business problems.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Highspot, Hubspot, Tableau, Salesloft, and other enablement tools highly preferred.

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also receive an annual cash bonus and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

Pay Range

raw.title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Business Officer
raw.excerpt: Role DescriptionAs the Executive Business Partner to Dropbox’s Chief Business Officer, you’ll create leverage through exceptional executive administration, judgment, and follow-through.
raw.description:
Role Description

As the Executive Business Partner to Dropbox’s Chief Business Officer, you’ll create leverage through exceptional executive administration, judgment, and follow-through. You’ll own the details that help him and his team operate at its best: a strategic calendar, seamless travel, useful meetings, clear preparation, accurate communications, and thoughtful coordination across the Chief Business Officer’s team and the broader Dropbox leadership system.

This is a high-impact executive administration role in a fast-moving and evolving business. You’ll work closely with the CBO, his Chief of Staff, the Office of the CBO team, other executive admins, Chiefs of Staff, business partners, and senior cross-functional leaders. You’ll often need to make decisions with incomplete information, surface risks early, and keep work moving without creating unnecessary noise or rework.

This is an exceptional administration role where you’ll bring judgment and a point of view, but your primary responsibility is to make the executive and the operating system work better through accurate, proactive, collaborative execution. You’ll first learn the existing system, build trust, and develop pattern recognition — then you’ll bring best practices and your expertise to help reshape systems and make them work even better.

If you’re highly organized, calm under pressure, direct in your communication, persistent about follow through, and energized by making complex executive work feel simple, then this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own a complex calendar as a strategic operating tool, balancing executive priorities, customer and revenue commitments, leadership forums, preparation time, focus time, travel, and personal commitments
  • Support meeting prep by ensuring the right attendees, context, agendas, pre-reads, links, decision points, and follow-up actions are in place
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel end-to-end, including itineraries, ground transportation, hotel and meeting logistics, time-zone planning, contingency plans, and preparation or recovery time
  • Partner with the CBO’s Chief of Staff to maintain shared visibility into priorities, risks, requests, decisions, and follow-ups
  • Collaborate with other executive admins, Chiefs of Staff, business partners, and cross-functional leaders to resolve scheduling and operating needs without creating parallel processes or confusion
  • Support communication by tracking drafts, deadlines, approvals, distribution lists, links, and follow-through, ensuring that important messages are accurate and do not stall
  • Plan and execute executive meetings, offsites, and leadership events with strong attention to detail and a crisp focus on attendee experience, budget, and contingency planning
  • Maintain accurate administrative systems, including expenses, contacts, recurring meeting structures, action-item tracking, and relevant executive reference materials
  • Surface risks early, make recommendations, and own issues through resolution rather than simply completing the first task requested

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience supporting a senior executive, preferably a C-level executive or equivalent leader in a complex, fast-moving organization
  • Expertise managing a highly complex executive calendar across multiple time zones, competing priorities, recurring leadership forums, customer commitments, and protected personal or focus time
  • Experience planning complex domestic and international travel, including contingency planning and coordination across multiple travelers, hosts, vendors, and time zones
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate directly, concisely, and appropriately with senior leaders and cross-functional partners
  • Experience working with and/or for a senior Chief of Staff in tight, trusted partnership on systems- and process-based approaches to make order out of competing priorities
  • Proven ability to prioritize independently, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and escalate risks early with a recommendation
  • Demonstrated track record of accurate, detail-oriented execution across scheduling, events, communications, expenses, and follow-through
  • Experience working as part of an admin community and collaborating across executive offices rather than operating as an isolated support partner
  • Comfort working in a high-change environment where priorities shift quickly and the person must continuously re-plan without losing important details
  • High competency with workplace systems, including Slack, Gmail, Concur, Navan, Google Docs(and of course Dropbox!), as well as AI tooling for efficiency through human-machine partnership
  • Ability to work primarily on Eastern Time, with flexibility for occasional EMEA and APJ commitments and executive travel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Chief Business Officer, Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, or another executive responsible for a broad, customer-facing organization
  • Experience working in technology, SaaS, or another business with complex customer, revenue, and cross-functional operating rhythms
  • Experience supporting executive customer engagements, leadership offsites, board-related preparation, or S-team-level events
  • Experience using AI responsibly to improve administrative workflows while personally validating accuracy, privacy, judgment, and final outputs
  • Project or program management experience that complements, but does not replace, strong executive administration fundamentals

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Canada Pay Range
$118,200—$159,900 CAD

26WD99788 Sr. Applied AI/ML Developer

Position overview

As a Senior ML Developer on the team, you will be responsible for leading/contributing to the design, analysis, and delivery of data-driven solutions to significant business challenges across dedicated RAG programs of work. Your horizontal expertise in testing, evaluation and causal inference in the vertical domain of user interaction with text outputs, Information Retrieval as a theoretical discipline as the enabling tool will drive end-to-end planning, POC-building, offline and online evaluation and pushing features into the hands of users.

The Senior MLE will work to deliver ML-driven technical solutions to customer needs in our platform. Sr MLEs help in coordinating delivery as part of multi-disciplinary stakeholder teams. This role is hands-on, focusing on technical problem solving with the latest in NLP and ML technology.

Our team culture is built on collaboration, mutual support, and continuous learning. As a Senior MLE, you will provide technical guidance and expertise for the team, and with other stakeholders. We emphasize an agile, hands-on, and technical approach at all levels of the team.

As a group, we want to continuously improve our Machine Learning as well as our knowledge of trends and techniques relevant to our areas. Our team strives for excellence in the theory and practice of Machine Learning. We encourage personal development and knowledge sharing.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Machine Learning capabilities that improve Autodesk’s RAG platforms

  • Perform statistical and data analysis and exploration to generate datasets for model training and development

  • Collaborate with other members of the team to reach better solutions, and to position our team at the cutting edge of technology and ML practice

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship for less-experienced members of the team to deliver key ML-powered features for our Digital Customer Platform.

  • Partner with stakeholders, to solve important business objectives across a range of problems

  • Translate business requirements and objectives into problems that can be solved with a combination of Data, Statistics, and Machine Learning

Minimum Qualifications

  • MS/M.Tech/M.Math/ or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Developer, Economics, Computational Linguistics or related fields

  • 3+ years of applicable work experience in ML

  • Hands-on experience of NLU and integrating traditional search techniques into RAG

  • Proficiency with the Python Machine Learning stack, e.g. Pandas, deep learning frameworks, traditional ML, probability calibration etc.

  • Knowledge of experimental design and analysis of results

  • Demonstrate experience with leading Machine Learning teams in deploying and improving ML features in production

  • Demonstrate experience working in cross-functional teams to deliver ML solutions in production

26WD99788 Développeur principal en IA/apprentissage automatique appliqué

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que développeur principal en apprentissage automatique au sein de l’équipe, vous serez chargé de diriger ou de contribuer à la conception, à l’analyse et à la mise en œuvre de solutions fondées sur les données afin de relever des défis d’affaires majeurs dans le cadre de programmes de travail RAG dédiés. Votre expertise horizontale en matière de tests, d’évaluation et d’inférence causale dans le domaine vertical de l’interaction des utilisateurs avec les sorties textuelles, ainsi que la recherche d’information en tant que discipline théorique et outil facilitateur, vous permettront de piloter la planification de bout en bout, la création de preuves de concept (POC), l’évaluation hors ligne et en ligne, ainsi que la mise à disposition des fonctionnalités auprès des utilisateurs.

Le spécialiste principal en apprentissage automatique (MLE) travaillera à fournir des solutions techniques basées sur l’apprentissage automatique pour répondre aux besoins des clients sur notre plateforme. Les spécialistes principaux en apprentissage automatique aident à coordonner la mise en œuvre au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires composées de parties prenantes. Ce poste est axé sur la pratique et met l’accent sur la résolution de problèmes techniques à l’aide des dernières technologies en traitement du langage naturel (TLN) et en apprentissage automatique.

La culture de notre équipe repose sur la collaboration, le soutien mutuel et l’apprentissage continu. En tant que spécialiste principal en apprentissage automatique, vous fournirez des conseils techniques et votre expertise à l’équipe ainsi qu’aux autres parties prenantes. Nous mettons l’accent sur une approche agile, pratique et technique à tous les niveaux de l’équipe.

En tant que groupe, nous souhaitons améliorer continuellement notre apprentissage automatique ainsi que notre connaissance des tendances et des techniques pertinentes pour nos domaines. Notre équipe vise l’excellence tant dans la théorie que dans la pratique de l’apprentissage automatique. Nous encourageons le développement personnel et le partage des connaissances.

Responsabilités

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des capacités d’apprentissage automatique qui améliorent les plateformes RAG d’Autodesk

  • Effectuer des analyses et des explorations statistiques et de données afin de générer des ensembles de données pour l’entraînement et le développement de modèles

  • Collaborer avec les autres membres de l’équipe pour trouver de meilleures solutions et positionner notre équipe à la fine pointe de la technologie et des pratiques en matière d’apprentissage automatique

  • Assurer le leadership technique et le mentorat auprès des membres moins expérimentés de l’équipe afin de livrer des fonctionnalités clés basées sur l’apprentissage automatique pour notre plateforme client numérique.

  • Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour atteindre des objectifs d’affaires importants en abordant un large éventail de problèmes

  • Traduire les exigences et les objectifs d’affaires en problèmes pouvant être résolus grâce à une combinaison de données, de statistiques et d’apprentissage automatique

Qualifications Minimales

  • Maîtrise (MS/M.Tech/M.Math) ou doctorat (Ph.D.) en informatique, statistiques, mathématiques, physique, développement logiciel, économie, linguistique computationnelle ou dans des domaines connexes

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente en apprentissage automatique

  • Expérience pratique de la compréhension du langage naturel (NLU) et de l’intégration de techniques de recherche traditionnelles dans le RAG

  • Maîtrise de la pile d’apprentissage automatique en Python, p. ex. Pandas, les cadres d’apprentissage profond, l’apprentissage automatique traditionnel, l’étalonnage des probabilités, etc.

  • Connaissance de la conception expérimentale et de l’analyse des résultats

  • Expérience avérée dans la direction d’équipes d’apprentissage automatique pour le déploiement et l’amélioration de fonctionnalités d’apprentissage automatique en production

  • Expérience avérée de travail au sein d’équipes interfonctionnelles pour la mise en œuvre de solutions d’apprentissage automatique en production

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Brokerage Casualty you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the Primary Casualty line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. Broker assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and broker relationships. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, brokers and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • In partnership with Consultant/Manager researches market trends, competition and market viability as well as develops an active working partnership with Actuarial, Finance and Claims as appropriate.

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned brokers and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure, determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves team/individual production and loss ratio goals with assigned brokers through sound management and marketing. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results of assigned brokers by agency, state, major class of business, etc. Continually assess quality of broker submissions and makes corrective action recommendations.

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the broker and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with re-insurers.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with brokers, through frequent contact. Develops and maintains good rapport and resolves broker conflicts. Travels to broker offices as required for training or marketing visits. Entertains brokers visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting events and other marketing campaigns.

  • Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Underwriting Manager. No direct reports. Indirect reports not typically assigned.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Five years as a CL underwriter, excess & surplus lines experience preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of CL underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques. Knowledge of Rating plans and plan concepts. Knowledge of Treaty & Cultivate reinsurance concepts. Knowledge of the wholesale broker system and company operations. Knowledge of regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, verbally, and in writing, inter personally with individuals and groups via telephone, video conference fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Limited travel out of state may be required. In-town entertaining required as necessary after normal business hours.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).

About the Role

We are seeking a Scientist, Precision Medicine / Bioinformatics (Quantitative Biomarker Sciences) to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Bioinformatics Scientist, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in biomarker data analysis, pipeline automation, data quality oversight, and cross-study data integration. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes and regulated practices, and contribute to study operations from planning through data delivery.

Responsibilities include executing well-defined analytical requests, maintaining data processing pipelines, performing quality control checks, building interactive data visualization tools, and supporting AI-assisted analysis code development. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, this role offers pathways to deepen your expertise in precision medicine, biomarker science, and bioinformatics while making a meaningful impact on clinical research outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute data analysis and visualization tasks with minimal supervision, including figure and analysis updates, pipeline execution, data quality control, and results delivery
  • Run and optimize automated data processing pipelines, perform routine quality control on outputs, document run parameters and versions, and generate analytical outputs
  • Build and refresh interactive data viewers using RMarkdown, Quarto, or Shiny for single-study and cross-study data exploration; package and publish outputs in agreed team formats
  • Support cross-study database integration activities including data collation, standardization, variable mapping, identifier harmonization, and validation
  • Contribute to experiment preparation activities such as generating balanced sample layouts and coordinating downstream submission steps
  • Maintain a reusable library of prompts, code snippets, and workflows for common bioinformatics tasks; establish coding standards and provide guidance on AI-assisted analysis workflows

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced proficiency in R programming and R Shiny for data analysis and interactive visualization
  • Strong expertise in biomarker data analytics, high-dimensional proteomic datasets, and data quality management
  • Experience with version control tools (GitHub) and working within regulated environments with strict compliance practices
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash scripting for data processing and automation
  • Familiarity with AI tools and the ability to quickly learn emerging technologies
  • Experience with biological, clinical, or preclinical data analysis in life sciences
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working effectively in cross-functional environments
  • Excellent English language proficiency (spoken and written)

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, Life Sciences, or related discipline
  • 4+ years of programming experience, preferably in life sciences or clinical research environments
  • Demonstrated expertise in R programming, R Shiny, and Bash scripting
  • Hands-on experience with biomarker data analytics and proteomic data analysis
  • Proficiency with version control tools (Git/GitHub) and experience following SOPs in regulated environments
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Computational Biology, or related field
  • Experience with Olink proteomic platform or other high-dimensional biomarker technologies
  • Knowledge of cardiovascular, metabolic, immunology, hematology, oncology, renal, neurodegenerative, or rare genetic disease research
  • Familiarity with basic statistical modeling fundamentals (linear/logistic models, survival analysis, multiple testing correction)
  • Experience with Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. For a complete list of benefits, please visit www.parexel.com/us-benefits.

Satisfaction comes from finding solutions that provide the best coverage and give our partner agents a way to differentiate themselves from the competition. raw.description:
About Eve
Eve is redefining legal technology for plaintiff law firms, and we're building the team that will take us there. We help firms handle more cases, recover more for clients, and grow with AI that works across every stage of a case, from intake through resolution. The next generation of great plaintiff firms will be AI-Native, and Eve is how they get there. But what makes Eve different isn't just the product. It's how we build it. If you're someone who takes ownership, stays curious, and wants to build AI that's already changing how law is practiced, this is where you belong.

Product-market fit: Eve is trusted by over 1000+ law firms, and we’re growing fast.
Backed by top investors: We’ve raised over $160M from world-class partners including Spark Capital, Andreessen Horowitz(A16z), Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed.
Built by a world-class team: Engineers, designers, and operators from places like Scale, Meta, Airbnb, Cruise, Square, Rubrik, and Lyft are building Eve from the ground up.
AI-Native from day one: We’re on the bleeding edge of AI, collaborating directly with teams at OpenAI and Anthropic to build best-in-class AI workflows tailored for legal work.
Explosive growth: We are growing 2X revenue Quarter over Quarter.

Lead Eve's response when a customer runs into a serious product, integration, delivery or adoption problem. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will build and run the customer escalation program, personally lead complex recoveries and work directly with customer executives and with Customer Success, Support, Product and Engineering.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You decide how serious each escalation is, who owns the recovery and which cases you lead yourself. Support, Product, Engineering and Delivery keep ownership of diagnosis, fixes, release timing and project work. You make sure the customer's problem is understood, prioritized and decided, and that the outcome works for the customer.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and run one view of every flagged customer risk and escalation. Set severity based on customer impact and urgency, name an accountable owner and next step for each case, and decide which cases need your direct leadership.
  • Personally lead complex recovery plans and executive customer conversations. Agree actions, owners and dates with the teams doing the work, and keep customers informed as the situation changes, without promising fixes or dates those teams have not agreed.
  • Bring technical judgment to customer issues. Work with Support, Product and Engineering to understand failures, dependencies and possible remedies, then translate the findings into clear customer communication.
  • Get decisions made across teams. Set decision deadlines, and when priority or resource conflicts block progress, take the tradeoff and your recommendation to the VP of Customer Success and the relevant functional leaders.
  • Close recoveries on evidence. Agree exit criteria, confirm the recovery work is complete and return the customer to their usual account team. Keep the Customer Success Manager involved throughout.
  • Identify recurring causes of escalations and work with the responsible teams to improve the product, delivery process and customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience personally leading complex enterprise software escalations, customer recovery or technical account engagements.
  • A hands-on technical background, such as support engineering, solutions engineering or architecture, technical account management or implementation engineering. You can work through complex issues with engineers, test assumptions and separate symptoms from underlying causes.
  • A record of communicating clearly with customer executives during difficult situations and earning trust through follow-through.
  • Experience building an escalation or customer risk program, including prioritization, accountable owners and clear criteria for resolution.
  • Sound judgment under pressure and the ability to secure decisions across teams without direct management authority.
  • Experience using data, AI or automation to identify emerging problems and improve follow-through, while checking the quality of the underlying information.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with legal technology, enterprise integrations or complex software implementations.
  • Incident management experience, including leading the response to high-severity customer issues.
  • Experience improving a recurring product or delivery problem using evidence from customer escalations.

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring, as we launch new data centers in APAC and expand fast. This is not a "write scripts for configs" role: you'll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn't. At this stage of our APAC growth you will be hands-on: writing code, making architectural decisions and owning your area end to end, with real autonomy. Then you will grow the local engineering team around you.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification
  • Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails
  • Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations
  • Close "last mile" gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it
  • Own architecture and technical decisions for your area in APAC, and align them with the European teams
  • Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling
  • Hire and onboard the first engineers in the region, set code quality and engineering standards, and mentor the team

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical background), including experience as a tech lead or team lead with broad ownership
  • Strong coding skills and ownership mindset: you can ship and operate reliable services
  • Proficiency in Go or readiness to switch; Python is also welcome (other languages can be useful for OSS debugging/fixes)
  • Ability to work autonomously in an early-stage environment, make decisions with incomplete information, and build processes from scratch
  • Willingness to stay hands-on while leading and growing a team
  • You don't have to be a Network expert, but we expect you to have interest in infrastructure and/or network

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Background in networking (ex-network engineer, CCNP/education, DC networking exposure) or strong interest and proven ability to learn fast
  • Experience building automation/infra tooling: CI/CD, IaC, testing/staging environments, or "network-as-code" style workflows
  • Low-level networking / datapath experience: eBPF/XDP, DPDK, kernel networking, traffic processing systems
  • Experience designing high-load services and observability platforms (metrics/logs/traces, alerting, regression detection)
  • Contributions to open source or experience extending/debugging OSS components in production environments
  • Experience building an engineering team from scratch or launching a new engineering hub

We expect Engineers to:

  • Manage large-scale projects involving multiple stakeholders across regions
  • Break down complex tasks and guide both their own work and that of more junior colleagues
  • Be experts in specific technologies and write high-quality code that can serve as a reference
  • Assess task priority and focus on high-impact work, avoiding low-value efforts
  • Have strong architectural thinking and contribute to system design
  • Lead hiring in the region: define the profile, run interviews, and make hiring decisions
  • Share knowledge and mentor others

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

raw.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As an Account Executive, Federal - US Air Force (Remote), you will serve as the strategic driving force behind Everpure’s expansion within the United States Air Force and Department of the Air Force accounts. You will champion our cutting-edge, data-centric infrastructure solutions to modernize mission-critical systems, accelerate cloud and data initiatives, and solve complex operational challenges across Air Force bases and commands. In this high-impact role, you will lead cross-functional pursuit teams and align closely with key defense integration partners to expand Everpure's footprint across federal defense programs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Mission & Campaign Execution: Formulate and execute multi-year strategic account plans across key US Air Force commands to secure net-new program wins, drive data modernization initiatives, and achieve quarterly and annual quota targets.
  • Federal Channel & Partner Ecosystem: Mobilize and align cross-functional pursuit teams—including systems engineers, federal systems integrators (FSIs), defense contractors, and specialized channel partners—to capture major defense procurement opportunities and program rollouts.
  • Pipeline Development & Account Penetration: Cultivate a robust, multi-quarter sales pipeline by establishing direct, trust-based relationships with program executive offices (PEOs), base commanders, IT directors, and C-suite defense leaders.
  • Data Infrastructure Solution Selling: Articulate the strategic value of the Everpure™ Platform—including FlashArray, FlashBlade, and Everpure™ Cloud—to showcase proven total cost of ownership, cyber-resiliency, and operational speed for defense applications.
  • Program Success & Expansion: Partner with post-sales customer success and technical service teams to ensure seamless platform integration, long-term operational excellence, and mission success across all deployed systems.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Federal Defense Sales Mastery: Demonstrated expertise navigating complex Department of Defense (DoD) procurement vehicles, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), and enterprise IT solution sales into the US Air Force or military branches.
  • Consultative & Strategic Mindset: Strong capability to dissect complex defense technology challenges and position advanced data platform capabilities that align with mission-critical outcomes.
  • Partner Alignment & Ecosystem Collaboration: Skilled in co-selling alongside federal systems integrators, defense prime contractors, and authorized federal distribution networks.
  • Clearance & Technical Acumen: Familiarity with federal security compliance standards, DoD data mandates, and active security clearance (or eligibility to obtain one) to interface across secured environments.

Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.

This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.

There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

The annual base salary range is:
$130,000—$228,000 USD

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at if you’re invited to an interview.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

About the Business


LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

About the Role


This position provides assistance and input to management, develops and leads large multi-functional development activities, solves complex technical problems, writes complex code for computer systems, and serves as a senior source of expertise. The position may also provide sizing or budget recommendations to management.

Accountabilities:


  • Business & Product Leadership; Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver analytics and technology solutions that support business goals. Prioritize the team roadmap, drive data-informed decision-making, communicate progress and recommendations to leadership, and ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory standards. Define and measure success through business impact, solution quality, and user adoption.
  • Data & Platform Management: Lead the development and maintenance of scalable data, analytics, and automation solutions. Ensure data quality, platform reliability, operational excellence, and efficient use of cloud and technology resources while promoting modern engineering practices and automation.
  • People Leadership & Execution: Recruit, mentor, and develop technical teams across analytics and data disciplines. Manage resources, budgets, priorities, and delivery risks while fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution. Provide technical leadership, support strategic planning, and serve as a subject-matter expert within the organization.

Required Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant professional experience in one or more of: data engineering; data science or machine learning; business intelligence or advanced analytics; or DevOps, DataOps, MLOps, or cloud-platform engineering.
  • Experience leading technical teams and managing people, capacity, and delivery while remaining hands-on technically.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language, such as Python.
  • Experience designing and operating production-grade data, analytics, ML, or cloud-platform solutions.
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI solutions in production, including generative AI and LLM applications using patterns such as RAG, embeddings, vector databases, fine-tuning, and agentic workflows.
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks and platforms (e.g., PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI).

  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms, data warehouses or lakehouses, orchestration, CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security, scalability, and reliability.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities in a changing environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

raw.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Grafana Analytics| NASA | (Remote, Canada)
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Fullstack Engineer - Grafana Analytics

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business via general data analytics. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on data from across the enterprise. We build systems that help users make sense of their sea of data through AI-driven features in use cases like product analytics and sales data. These capabilities lower the barrier of domain expertise and surface meaningful signals from messy data.

The Grafana Analytics team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer with a strong software engineering background, a quick iteration mindset, and a passion for experimentation – balanced by a focus on shipping and scaling impactful features that deliver value to users. This new team works like a startup within the company: you'll wear multiple hats and won't rely on cross-functional teams that typically support other teams inside Grafana Labs engineering. You will design, develop, test, and ship AI-powered features that can manage dealing with large datasets, while also expanding the capabilities of analytics-focused AI agents to assist users with information retrieval. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build and deliver full-stack user experiences: Take ownership of developing delightful, high-performance AI features to help users discover, organize, and optimize access to large datasets.
  • Rapid experimentation and iteration: Implement a highly iterative process where you quickly prototype, test, and validate with real users, including shipping and evolving LLM- or agent-powered workflows for the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Collaborate: Work with the rest of the team to shape AI-driven product features, including the integration of agentic components with internal tools like Slack and alerting systems while engaging with internal data teams for dogfooding.
  • Utilize AI tools effectively: Use AI and automation tools to enhance both product functionality and your own development workflows.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What we're looking for:

  • Product mindset: You understand what problems users have and develop solutions to address those with proficiency and taste.
  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.

Requirements:

  • Track record of building user-facing experiences that strike the right balance between utility and delighting the user.
  • Experience with LLMs, context engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Nice to have (but not required):

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Canada the Base compensation range for this role is $164,490 - $197,389 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This position is part of the AI Risk Governance team — a dedicated advisory function within Enterprise Risk Management.


  • Provide technical depth to assess AI/ML and generative AI systems, and translate technical realities into clear risk language for both practitioners and risk partners.
  • Advise first-line teams on risk management throughout the AI lifecycle, tailoring guidance to each use case's context rather than applying one-size-fits-all rules, so teams can contextualize AI risk and build fit-for-purpose mitigation strategies.
  • Keep risk controls current with rapidly evolving AI technology (including agentic AI), anticipating emerging risks and updating guidance and control expectations ahead of scaled deployment.
  • Serve as a trusted, credible advisor who connects and aligns risk partners across all three lines on AI risk matters.
  • Support the operationalization of AI risk management through agentic AI — designing and building AI agents, automations, or purpose-built tooling that scale risk guidance and embed risk controls into practitioners' workflows.
  • Contribute to shared legal and compliance support, assembling audit-ready evidence and helping produce credible, timely responses to regulator and examiner inquiries.
  • Communicate complex technical and risk concepts in plain language, building practitioner fluency and confidence in managing AI risk through training and education.

Compensation Grade: G5


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.


It is our intention to fill this role in Columbus, OH. However, applications from candidates working remotely who bring critical industry skills and relevant experience may be considered.


Job Description Summary

Do you have the desire to play a critical role in driving data-based business outcomes? At Nationwide, our Analytic professionals are responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying business opportunities using scientific research methods, statistics, machine learning and data visualization techniques. They participate in all phases of the analytic lifecycle, from research design, data collection and data processing to model building, deployment and presentation of results. Our industry-leading workforce adopts an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to know more about you!

As an Analytic Solutions Advisor, you’ll be responsible for working with Nationwide business leaders and data scientists to design and implement advanced analytics solutions that deliver deep insights and translate into high business value to our organization. To succeed, you’ll need to use business knowledge and a solid understanding of advance analytics (e.g., artificial intelligence, machine learning, etc.) to prioritize business problems and convey goals to data science professionals. You’ll have the opportunity to work with various technologies from big data, relational and SQL databases, unstructured data technology and programming languages such as SQL and Python.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads advanced analytics projects. Consults with business partners to define and structure analytic projects. Analyzes trends and patterns in structured and unstructured data and synthesizes and communicates relevant insights to project teams and business partners using advanced analytics techniques. May lead multiple concurrent projects.

  • Builds, packages and communicates analytic work (synthesis) using appropriate medium for relevant insights and applicable data visualizations. Uses statistical techniques to determine patterns and predict future business outcomes and trends.

  • Synthesizes project work and the work of team members. Work may span more than one project or focus area. Plans and manages execution of work, participates in planning, and delivers on commitments. Develops scope, risk/control matrix, project timelines and assignments.

  • Collaborates with leadership to develop analytics strategies for the business unit. Consults with business to understand, align and deliver analytics work that supports business objectives and priorities.

  • Designs analytics solutions aligned to business needs using statistical, database and/or general programming languages and tools.

  • Reviews analytic solution design and provide relevant feedback and coaching to project team associates.

  • Builds and manages relationships and serve as a trusted business advisor to clients, partners in Enterprise Analytics Office, Technology, Advanced Analytics Hubs, and other partners. . Builds partnerships across the enterprise to enhance analytics capabilities.

  • Contributes to the continuous improvement of department processes through ongoing initiatives.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Manager/Director Data Leader.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies in statistics, actuarial science, engineering or related quantitative field, business science or MBA preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Certifications are not required but encouraged.

Experience: Typically, eight or more years of related work experience.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Proven understanding of advanced analytics theory and experience with application in a key project and/or program. Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with all levels of associates, senior management and vendors. Proficient in working with cross-functional teams to drive project execution.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Onboarding Project Manager (OPM). Qualified candidates can work remotely in S. Korea.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director, Global Client Onboarding (GCO), the Onboarding Project Manager (OPM) is responsible for assuring the successful onboarding of Rimini Street’s top clients across all supported product lines.

The OPM is responsible for leading the successful on-time completion of the client onboarding project plan. Key tasks include developing the Onboarding Project plan, establishing client and Rimini Street project roles and responsibilities, identifying project risk areas, creating risk mitigation plans and managing all escalations related these accounts. The OPM will manage all executive and project reporting, both with the client and to the Rimini Street internal management teams.

The OPM needs to have excellent communication with client contacts and the project teams. The OPM is also expected to contribute to client onboarding projects, improvements and innovations.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for successful, on-time completion of client onboarding projects
  • Leads internal teams to execute client onboarding processes and tasks to assure successful, on-time completion of all deliverables
  • Develops and drives onboarding project risk mitigation and leads all escalations related to these projects
  • Provide pre-sales client onboarding assistance for the sales organization
  • Ensures onboarding tasks are performed in accordance with ISO processes
  • Maintain up-to-date project information in Salesforce.com and other systems
  • Manage client communications and escalations during the onboarding process
  • Provide detailed and timely status reporting to internal management team
  • Assure excellent client satisfaction with entire onboarding process
  • Secure client reference ability at conclusion of onboarding
  • Identify and propose onboarding innovations and improvement opportunities
  • 10% travel expected

Education & Certification

  • Bachelor and/or Master’s Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Project Management certification or equivalent desired
  • SAP or Oracle Implementation and/or technical certifications desired

Experience

  • Significant consulting or project management experience working with SAP, Oracle EBS Applications or Oracle Database solutions, including strong client management experience
  • 5+ years ERP application implementation and/or upgrade project management experience
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Excellent organizational, communication, interpersonal, relationship building skills
  • Technical consulting experience preferred

Qualifications & Skills

  • Native Korean Speaker
  • Fluency in English essential
  • Project management
  • Escalation management
  • Negotiation and Objection-Handling skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to successfully execute the Onboarding Project Plan with successful results

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role

We are seeking a Regulatory Strategy Senior Associate to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Regulatory Strategy Senior Associate, you will support regulatory strategy initiatives that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in regulatory pathway planning, agency engagement support, and strategic compliance oversight. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to regulatory strategy from planning through implementation. Responsibilities include developing regulatory pathway recommendations, supporting agency engagement planning, and identifying key risks and opportunities, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence regulatory outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic regulatory guidance and product development support. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Regulatory Strategy Senior Associate can explore career paths and expand skills across regulatory affairs and clinical development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and recommend regulatory pathways for assigned products, studies, or markets

    • Identify key regulatory risks and opportunities to inform development strategy
    • Align regulatory approaches with development and commercialization objectives
    • Maintain current knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry guidance
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure regulatory compliance and strategic alignment
    • Prepare regulatory documentation and submissions as needed
    • Track regulatory timelines and milestones to support program execution

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in regulatory strategy, strategic thinking, and problem-solving
    • Experience working in regulatory affairs, clinical development, or a regulated environment
    • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders
    • A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
    • Comfort working with regulatory databases, submission tracking systems, and standard office tools

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, regulatory affairs, pharmacy, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
    • 4+ years of experience in regulatory affairs, clinical development, or a related field

    • FDA regulation expertise/knowledge is required and experience with other global markets is preferred
    • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
    • Experience with regulatory databases or submission tracking systems
    • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in regulatory affairs, pharmacy, or related field
    • Experience in specific therapeutic areas or development phases
    • Familiarity with regulatory submission software or electronic tracking systems
    • Experience supporting FDA or international regulatory submissions
