At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

We are hiring for a Functional Lead, AI & Agentforce Delivery with a strong understanding of Salesforce & AI solutions who will manage and support customer-facing Agentforce and AI implementation projects, in particular implementation projects leveraging NeuraFlash products and solution accelerators. The ideal candidate has the ability to plan and think strategically, as well as dive into project details to manage the project on the ground. The AI & Agentforce Functional Lead is professional and confident in front of critical customer stakeholders. Ideal candidates will have a strong analytical, consultative mindset and thrive in an agile environment. They will also have AI tooling experience to leverage in project delivery. If you appreciate working with cutting edge technology and delivering exciting new solutions - this role is for you!

You'll have the opportunity to:

Manage overall delivery of Agentforce and AI implementation projects, in particular implementation projects leveraging NeuraFlash products and solution accelerators. You will act as functional lead on the project to oversee and shape the overall solution and manage day to day work and customer relationships. You will:

  • Act as a “thought leader” for our customers, guiding the customer and NeuraFlash team in the definition of use cases and business outcomes
  • Smoothly transition customers from the sales process to project delivery. This includes: Reviewing the SOW and any partner-funding POs, defining project roles and responsibilities for kick off, and facilitating kick off and client onboarding
  • Plan, monitor and manage project financials, scope, and schedule to ensure project stays on track for assigned client projects
  • Act as primary day-to-day point of contact for the client and the operational aspects of the project, including a focus on building strong customer relationships
  • Facilitate or co-lead with customer project manager regular status meetings with project team, sponsors, and all stakeholders
  • Manage NeuraFlash project team members in the delivery of the solution
  • Readout documented and measured outcomes for live solutions prior to project closeout
  • Stay informed on Agentic Division internal initiatives, products, and solutions to foster innovation and efficiencies on your projects

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience as a delivery leader overseeing AI-related implementation of business solutions on Salesforce or AWS platform across all phases of project delivery
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to audiences of all levels
  • Experience working in a professional services/consulting environment
  • Experience leading delivery as project manager or scrum leader
  • Experience with estimation/sizing and SOW/Change Order contracting
  • Certified Salesforce Admin + Sales Cloud or Service Cloud Consultant certifications
  • Demonstrated track record of writing SOWs and Change Requests and managing scope

Preferred Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Information Technology or Management

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. For details, view a copy of the Accenture Equal Opportunity Statement

Accenture is an EEO and Affirmative Action Employer of Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

Accenture is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce and Google Cloud have embarked on a groundbreaking partnership worth $2.5 billion to revolutionize customer relationship management (CRM) through advanced artificial intelligence (AI). By integrating Google's Gemini AI models into Salesforce's Agentforce platform, we're enabling businesses to harness multi-modal AI capabilities—processing images, audio, and video—to deliver unparalleled customer experiences. Join our team of talented engineers and help us advance the integration of Salesforce applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

We are seeking a proactive and skilled Software Security Engineer to join our GCP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing our security posture across various domains, focusing on development, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, and the security of distributed and scalable distributed systems. This role requires hands-on experience with security systems, a deep understanding of modern threats, and the ability to drive security improvements through engineering solutions.

As a Software Security Engineer, you won’t just find vulnerabilities, you’ll engineer the systems that prevent them. You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:

  • Security Engineering & Automation: Build and integrate high-performance security tools and custom scripts into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST/DAST, SCA, SIEM) to automate manual toil.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and secure Terraform/IaC templates to ensure our cloud infrastructure is hardened by design before it ever reaches production.
  • Vulnerability Leadership: Lead the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle, using a risk-based approach to prioritize remediation across network, cloud, and application layers.
  • Architecture & Threat Modeling: Partner with DevOps and Product teams to conduct threat modeling and architectural reviews, ensuring new features are resilient and scalable.
  • Compliance & Governance: Act as the technical lead for audits (SOC2, ISO 27001), leveraging automation to provide evidence of consistent monitoring and timely closure of risks.
  • Production Resilience: Troubleshooting and resolving complex security issues in production using distributed tracing and modern monitoring tools.

You're Our Person If:

  • Engineering Mindset: 5+ years for SMTS, 7+ years for LMTS; 9+ years for PMTS in Security Engineering with a focus on building tools, not just managing them.
  • Coding Proficiency: Strong experience in Go, Java, or Python with a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and automation.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise: Deep experience with GCP (similar) and Terraform for managing cloud security posture (CSPM) and infrastructure.
  • Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.

Even Better If:

  • You know container security tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

As a Therapist at Blackbird Health, you’ll play a vital role in delivering high-quality virtual and in-person therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and their caregivers. You’ll build meaningful relationships with patients and families, taking the time to understand their needs, support engagement in treatment, and educate them on therapeutic approaches that foster long-term progress.

  • Flexible scheduling within business needs — set your own hours with emphasis on after-school and weekend availability

Blackbird Health is made up of intelligent, humble, compassionate and hardworking people. Joining the ranks means you'll have an automatic network to turn to for best practices, professional development, and opportunities to share your expertise.

raw.description:
Who You Are

You are a detail-oriented, experienced medical coder who understands that accurate coding is the foundation of a healthy revenue cycle. You bring strong outpatient coding expertise and a sharp eye for documentation - catching what others miss and knowing exactly how to translate a clinical encounter into a clean, compliant claim. You communicate confidently with providers and teammates, and you know how to make complex coding questions easier to understand. You thrive in a remote environment where you can take ownership of your work, manage competing priorities, and keep things moving. Most importantly, you care about getting it right - for our providers, our patients, and the business.

Who We Are

Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is building healthier communities by advancing primary care. We partner with patients, providers, and plans to provide personalized, local care for seniors across the country. We believe that patient needs come first, and that primary care is the foundation of patient-centric healthcare. With Oasis, patients receive better access and care. Providers receive the data, resources, and expertise to be successful in value-based care arrangements. Payors get the benefit of a solution that improves performance, drives growth, and reduces the total cost of care in hard-to-engage markets.

Together, we will boldly advance primary care for those that need it most. We are excited for you to join us on this journey. We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we listen first, do the right thing, build things together and go all in --- while having fun!

Your Role

Oasis is building a strong, scalable Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) offering to support independent and community-based primary care practices. As a Medical Coder, you will play a vital role in keeping the revenue cycle moving - from accurate outpatient coding and clean claim submission through coding-related denial resolution. You will work closely with providers and billing staff to ensure documentation supports accurate, compliant coding, and serve as a resource when coding questions arise. Your work will help reduce revenue leakage, improve clean claim rates, and create a better experience for the practices and patients we serve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes for outpatient encounters based on provider documentation
  • Enter and manage charges within eClinicalWorks (eCW)
  • Review and submit claims, ensuring accuracy and compliance prior to submission
  • Identify and resolve coding-related denials; resubmit corrected claims as needed
  • Collaborate with providers and billing staff to clarify documentation and coding questions
  • Stay current on payor policies, coding guideline updates, and compliance requirements
  • Support coding audits and quality reviews as needed

Investment In Our Team

We invest in the personal and professional success of our team. We take care of our people and offer robust benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and generous time off plans. We are committed to supporting your growth with a development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career. As an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team, you will partner with professionals who understand the importance of high-value, high-impact patient care.

About You

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) certification required
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in outpatient medical coding
  • Experience working in eClinicalWorks (eCW) preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and payor billing requirements
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payor guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to coding accuracy and compliance
  • Ability to independently manage priorities and follow work through to resolution in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Reliable internet access and the ability to maintain a HIPAA-compliant remote workspace
Hourly Pay Range
$24—$29 USD

The salary range listed reflects the full compensation range for this role level at Oasis and is designed to support growth over time. Actual offers may vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and alignment with the scope of the role. Offers near the top of the range are uncommon and generally reflect exceptionally deep, directly relevant experience.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without a current or future visa sponsorship. This role is open to applicants currently residing in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

If you want a career in healthcare and a lifestyle most people only dream about – with freshwater lakes, scenic trails, charming downtowns, a vibrant arts scene, and endless outdoor adventures - you might just be Munson Material. To us, that means teammates who live by our values of excellence, teamness, positivity, creativity, and a commitment to creating exceptional experiences for our patients and each other. Invested in You

raw.excerpt: Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small.
raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Principal Software Engineer at Coupa:

We're looking for someone who's rebuilt a production system while it was running. CSP (Coupa Supplier Platform) serves millions of supplier companies—it's where they find work, receive orders, issue invoices, and get paid. The platform started as a Rails monolith. It works, but it needs to evolve. More traffic, more features, multi-cloud deployment, higher availability requirements.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering. CSP operates as a nimble team outside the larger engineering org, moving fast and pioneering approaches that demonstrate what's possible. You'll work with Ruby on Rails, Golang, Java—and introduce whatever else the architecture needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architectural evolution. Traffic is growing, functionality is expanding, robustness matters more than ever. You'll define what changes, in what order, and why.
  • Set the patterns: API design, microservice boundaries, deployment pipelines, monitoring, reliability. Make them real, not theoretical.
  • Mentor engineers. Guide decisions. Review architecture and code. Build the kind of team that ships ambitious work.
  • Join the Architectural Steering Group. Share what you learn with Principal Engineers across Coupa. Import what works elsewhere.
  • Partner with SRE on cloud-native infrastructure: CI/CD, containers, infrastructure-as-code, multi-cloud capabilities.
  • Own security, multi-tenancy isolation, data governance, and compliance across all regions.
  • Work with product, design, and business teams to turn supplier workflows into systems that scale.

What You Will Bring to Coupa

  • 15+ years building B2B SaaS at scale. You've held leadership and architectural roles where your decisions stuck around.
  • Real experience evolving legacy systems into microservices—in production, with users depending on uptime.
  • Deep knowledge of API-driven services, multi-tenant architectures, and B2B integration patterns that handle millions of users.
  • Solid foundation in modern deployment: CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, working with cloud providers like AWS or GCP.
  • Comfort across technology stacks (Rails, Golang, Java) and the judgment to pick tools that solve problems, not resume lines.
  • Track record mentoring teams—providing direction without micromanaging, staying technical without bottlenecking.
  • Problem-solving skills that balance scale, performance, technical debt, and shipping features. You know the trade-offs because you've lived them.
  • Communication skills that work across engineering, product, and business. You build consensus without watering down hard truths.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

Founded in 1920, Eastman is a global specialty materials company that produces a broad range of products found in items people use every day. With the purpose of enhancing the quality of life in a material way, Eastman works with customers to deliver innovative products and solutions while maintaining a commitment to safety and sustainability. The company’s innovation-driven growth model takes advantage of world-class technology platforms, deep customer engagement, and differentiated application development to grow its leading positions in attractive end markets such as transportation, building and construction, and consumables. As a globally inclusive company, Eastman employs approximately 13,000 people around the world and serves customers in more than 100 countries. The company had 2025 revenue of approximately $8.8 billion and is headquartered in Kingsport, Tennessee, USA. For more information, visit www.eastman.com.

Role Profile

This role will be an MDM on an innovation platform within Eastman’s CASE division. The person in this role will be responsible for the development and execution of strategies to activate brands and the value chain for coated paper articles and flexible packaging used in the food service and consumer packaged goods (CPG) industries. This role requires up to 30% travel.

Key Accountabilities

  • Earnings: Drive variable margin gains by closing new business initiatives.
  • Growth: Measure growth by launch effectiveness, projected revenue from Gate 5 launches, and new business from market development and innovation.
  • Talent Management: Provide marketing expertise and coaching to teams and manage personal career development.

This role is open to remote candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Contributes to the development of Addressable Market Maps and offers through segment cross-functional teams
  • Leads front end discovery to articulate where to play and how to win options in prioritized markets
  • Responsible for determining the best path for specific initiatives surfaced from market strategy work, developing the plans for execution, executing the plan (either directly or indirectly) and monitoring its effectiveness
  • Leads or supports growth projects as a Marketing resource by using the EBME framework to make quality strategic choices on all initiatives; assists others as needed
  • Establishes and tracks metrics to ensure post launch efforts are contributing to the segment’s strategy and performance; provides recommendation to Marketing leaders if changes are needed
  • Enters new opportunities for initiatives into Leads Management (SFDC) so that leads can be properly managed and tracked as they are passed on to Sales
  • Make recommendations on potential growth initiatives in the market based on market trends and insights, as well as customer discovery
  • Creates understanding of value of Eastman offerings vs. alternatives by developing Economic Value Estimates (EVE™)
  • Develops transition plans and materials as well as provides coaching to Sales and other supporting functions in preparation for a new product launch
  • Communicates offers that tie to initiatives; offers may be new, existing, or revised
  • Draw conclusions from multiple sources to create insights that support growth projects
  • Networks and becomes an industry expert in assigned markets
  • Interfaces with leverage points through the value chain to identify potential product and application opportunities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree required; MBA or advanced education in strategic marketing required
  • 8+ years of experience in commercial, marketing, or product management roles
  • 5+ years experience launching new products in relevant markets (Preferred)
  • 5+ years working in marketing in the paper value chain, e.g., for a paper manufacturer or a converter / manufacturer of paper articles, engaging the flexible packaging and food service markets (Preferred)
  • Strong business and marketing acumen

  • Note: Eastman will not accept applicants for this offered position who require visa sponsorship, including those whose status is F-1 visa OPT who subsequently would require ongoing visa sponsorship.

The base salary range for this position is $140,000 to $192,500. ​

At Eastman, we are committed to transparency and integrity in our compensation practices. Eastman includes salary ranges in some job postings to provide clear compensation information and to be compliant with state laws that require disclosure. Not all postings display ranges due to factors like location, market conditions, or position specifics. Compensation is based on qualifications and experience. Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary questions during the interview process.

Benefits

Your total rewards go far beyond a competitive salary. When you join Eastman, you gain access to an exceptional suite of programs designed to protect your health, grow your wealth, and fuel your career.

Compensation & Incentives
• Base pay plus performance-based incentive opportunities that let you share in our success.

Health & Wellness
• Comprehensive medical, prescription-drug, and dental coverage—paired with a Health Savings Account option to help you save tax-free dollars for care today or in the future.
• A robust menu of voluntary benefits—including vision, optional life, critical-illness protection, and more—so you can tailor coverage to fit your life.
• Holistic wellness support: financial-planning tools, family-building assistance (adoption, pregnancy, and fertility resources), parental leave, and confidential Employee Assistance Program counseling.

Retirement & Financial Strategies
• 401(k) with a company match—plus an additional annual retirement contribution from Eastman to accelerate your long-term savings.

Time Away
• Eleven paid holidays, one personal day, paid time off, and paid vacation to recharge, celebrate, or handle life’s moments.

Growth & Development
• Access to mentorship, learning resources, and leadership programs that empower you to thrive in your current role and chart the next steps in your career.

At Eastman, we invest in the whole you—so you can bring your best self to work every day and build a future you’re proud of.

Eastman Chemical Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status or any other protected classes as designated by law.

Eastman is committed to creating a powerfully engaged workplace, where everyone can contribute to their fullest potential each day.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. About This Business Unit

Sargent & Lundy’s Government Services Division provides cutting-edge engineering design and consulting support to the management and operating contractors for US Department of Energy (DOE) sites and national laboratories. raw.title: Principal Sales Engineer - Canada
raw.excerpt: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise.
raw.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Principal Sales Engineer, you will have a significant impact on the success of each sales presentation in which you participate and will share in its financial rewards. In this key position, you will contribute directly to the bottom-line health of the company.

As a Principal Sales Engineer, you will lead the technical sales strategy, deliver advanced product demonstrations, and guide customers through complex solution architectures. You’ll mentor other sales engineers, collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to align customer feedback with roadmap priorities, and support executive-level discussions. Your deep understanding of our technology, market landscape, and customer challenges will allow you to design and advocate for customer-tailored solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Additionally, you will proactively resolve pre-sales technical challenges and act as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and customer stakeholders throughout the buying journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete mastery of all ExtraHop demo narratives
  • Sufficiently versatile with the ExtraHop platform to conduct any ad-hoc demo upon request
  • Key stakeholder in our demo creation/update process
  • Maintain documents that are key to the SE workflow; deployment guidelines, POC best-practices, compelling use-cases, etc.
  • Guide and mentor new ExtraHop SEs
  • Recognized throughout the company as an expert in specific technologies/domains
  • Recognized by peer SEs for their significant contributions that have benefited the broader SE community
  • Ability to create and deliver public speaking sessions, blog posts, social media activity and analyst interactions.
  • Interface with Product Management to relay market demands from prospects/customers and play a role in shaping the product roadmap
  • Play an active role in the continuous refinement of our POC process; scoping questions/materials, output documents and best practices for aligning POC results to compelling business value
  • Become an acknowledged expert in one or more competitive products and lend assistance to other SEs that encounter that vendor
  • Identify new areas of opportunity/revenue growth based on your customer/industry relationships and knowledge of the verticals we support
  • Expert SFDC user very familiar with our use of the tool and capable of suggesting improvements to our SFDC workflows that would benefit the SE organization
  • Considers the business at-large when advocating for product/process changes and is able to assess the situation from the perspective of other organizations within the company
  • Actively drives changes to SE/company processes; comes up with an idea, vets it with peers/leadership, fleshes it out and leads the execution in concert with other internal stakeholders
  • Expert-level understanding of the sales process; incorporates business requirements into the demo narrative, ensures POC outcomes are aligned with business impact, able to quickly/accurate qualify an opportunity
  • Mastery of solution design; capable of translating customer input into a solution architecture that seamlessly aligns with the business proposal being developed by the RSM

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 10-14 years selling Cloud and Cyber Security technology into large Enterprises with direct AWS, Azure or GCP experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or related area or demonstration of equivalent knowledge
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience working directly with cloud concepts
  • Complex and strategic selling experience required

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of enterprise-architecture concepts, risk management, and excellent working knowledge of key protocols across Layers 2-7 (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, SSL/TLS, etc.).
  • Expert level understanding of enterprise information technologies across the full OSI stack, cloud concepts (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • In-depth knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering Concepts
  • Familiarity with automation and infrastructure as code technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Cloud Formation
  • Conducts highly complex work critical to the organisation
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and leadership skills, acts as a role model and a mentor for other sales engineers.
  • Excellent communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills with the ability to interact and address Senior executive and technical audiences
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and have an ongoing desire to stay current with the latest technologies
  • Works without supervision with extensive latitude for independent judgement.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: must be capable of accurately assessing needs, maintaining a calm business demeanor, and taking quick action to resolve issues
  • Works cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders
  • Works well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Has predictable, reliable attendance.

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $190,000 CAD. This is a commission-eligible position with a 70/30 pay mix, for total target compensation of approximately $234,000 to $247,000 CAD at plan. Actual commission earnings are based on individual performance against quota.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

PPC Manager

Our Client, Nordzero, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, Canada and Europe is looking for a highly skilled and experienced professional to fill an immediate opening for Amazon PPC Manager for a full-time remote job.

As the Amazon PPC Manager, you will be responsible for managing our advertising efforts on Amazon, setting performance goals, elaborating PPC strategies, and ensuring the successful execution of Amazon PPC campaigns to drive sales and maximize profitability.

If you have a strong background in Amazon PPC advertising, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for driving success in the Ecommerce industry, we would love to hear from you.

About the Company:

At Nordzero we develop and sell products that help boost mood, well-being, beauty, and life quality every day. We want to create long-term added value for society. To ensure that our measures are effective, we set ourselves ambitious targets and measure our success. We actively strive to be more sustainable with all of our brands and products.

We are offering a modern working environment in a small company operating in a rapidly developing and international market. The collective is youthful and friendly, and many joint activities are undertaken together. You are offered the opportunity to approach your tasks creatively, generate new ideas and implement them.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive Amazon PPC strategies across our brands, to increase visibility, drive sales, and achieve KPIs
  • Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to identify high-performing keywords and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest trends, tools, and best practices in Amazon PPC advertising, sharing knowledge and implementing innovative strategies within the team.
  • Analyze data and generate actionable insights to improve campaign performance, conversion rates, and customer acquisition.
  • Prepare regular performance reports, highlighting key metrics, campaign results, and recommendations for further optimization.
  • Ensure compliance with Amazon's advertising policies and guidelines, staying informed about any changes or updates in the platform.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Amazon PPC advertising.
  • In-depth knowledge of Amazon PPC campaign management, including campaign types, targeting options, bid management, and keyword optimization.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing PPC budgets of over $50 and delivering strong ROI.
  • Expertise in using the Amazon Advertising platform, analytics tools, and data analysis techniques to measure and improve campaign performance.

raw.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose: Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing: At Ensono, security is more than monitoring alerts. It is about protecting our business and our clients through proactive detection, rapid response, and informed decision-making. We're looking for a Senior Security Analyst to join our Security Operations team and serve as a critical member of our incident response capability.

In this role, you'll investigate and respond to security events, analyze threats across a complex enterprise environment, and work closely with both internal teams and customers to contain and remediate security incidents. You'll act as a senior escalation point for security investigations, helping to distinguish real threats from noise while ensuring incidents are resolved quickly and effectively. This role is part of a broader incident response function and plays a key role in providing operational coverage and support for customer security environments.

After-hours and/or on-call duty is required.

Responsibilities include:

  • Strong technical writing skills to include the ability to provide clearly written and detailed reports on projects for communication to leaders
  • The monitoring and administration of information security solutions
  • Fill a Senior role in monitoring and responding to security incidents
  • Collect evidence to support internal and customer audit requirements
  • Create internal and customer facing security playbooks and procedures
  • Align to procedures, processes, and security tools to support a single global cybersecurity model
  • Provide guidance to and mentorship to junior members of the Security Operations team
  • Perform incident response roles as necessary per the Ensono Incident Response Plan
  • Implement security application upgrades and patches
  • Investigate security events, threats, and vulnerabilities
  • Follow project plans and meet timelines and milestones
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of security metrics
  • Collaborate across team to create and tune security alerts
  • Proactively learn new technologies and tooling capabilities throughout the workday
  • Assist product owners to ensure alignment of solutions to security product offerings
  • Operate effectively in a fast‑paced enterprise environment, independently prioritizing tasks to meet competing demands

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.  

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on Security Operations Center (SOC) experience supporting security monitoring, alert triage, incident investigation, escalation management, and incident response.
  • Experience leading or independently handling security investigations and incident response activities within a large enterprise, managed services, MSSP, MDR, or multi-customer environment.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel in a production environment, including alert investigation, log analysis, incident management, threat detection, and security monitoring.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender technologies, including the investigation and response of endpoint, identity, email, and cloud security incidents.
  • Experience working with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms and security monitoring tools to identify, investigate, and respond to security threats.
  • Experience distinguishing true-positive security events from false positives and making risk-based decisions in operational environments.
  • Experience communicating security incidents, technical findings, business impact, and remediation recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customers.
  • Experience creating and maintaining incident documentation, investigation records, security procedures, runbooks, and response playbooks.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, DNS, firewalls, encryption technologies, security controls, and common attack vectors.
  • Strong understanding of malware classification, attack methodologies, infection vectors, persistence mechanisms, and threat actor techniques.
  • Experience with digital forensics concepts, evidence preservation, log analysis, and investigative methodologies.
  • Experience evaluating vulnerability scan results and assessing vulnerability risks within enterprise environments.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, vulnerability management processes, and privileged access management concepts.
  • Experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP), endpoint security technologies, anti-malware solutions, and host-based intrusion detection/prevention concepts.
  • Experience using KQL, PowerShell, Python, SQL, or similar tools to support security investigations and operational efficiency.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to perform effectively during high-pressure security incidents.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Preferred security tooling experience:

  • Experience with Trend Vision One, Trend Micro security technologies, or other XDR platforms.
  • Experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, security automation, orchestration, and SOAR workflows.
  • Experience with Security-as-a-Service (SECaaS) security platforms.
  • Knowledge of network and cloud security concepts, including virtual firewalls, cloud-native security controls, and container technologies.
  • Familiarity with file integrity monitoring (FIM) technologies.
  • Experience supporting compliance and security frameworks such as PCI-DSS, SOC 1/SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, IRS Publication 1075, NIST, and ISO 27001

Certifications Required

  • One or more of the following certifications are highly desired:
    • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
    • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
    • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
    • GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
    • CompTIA CySA+
    • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
    • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $100,000 to $125,000 annually based on a full-time schedule. Please note that placement in the range may vary based on numerous factors including but not limited to skills, experience, internal equity, and business needs. In addition to base salary, other compensation programs, depending on eligibility, include an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance and an equity grant under our Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

raw.excerpt: The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration.
raw.description:
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
  • Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
  • Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
  • Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
  • Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
  • Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
  • Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
  • Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
  • Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.

Supervisory / Management Responsibilities

This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.

Key Competencies

  • Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
  • AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
  • Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
  • Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
  • Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
  • Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
  • Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.

Preferred Experience

  • Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
  • Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
  • Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
  • Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
  • External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
  • Experience working in agile product development environments.

This role can be remote. For those residing outside of the Bay Area, there is minimal travel required (4x/year to HQ). For those who live in the Bay Area, the company offers group office lunches on Tuesdays, so participation those days for team connection is strongly encouraged.

Responsibilities

    • Lead U.S. and international data privacy and consumer protection initiatives, including compliance with GDPR, CPRA, HIPAA, COPPA, PIPEDA, and other applicable privacy and data protection laws.
    • Develop, implement, and maintain privacy policies, governance frameworks, and related compliance programs.
    • Assess legal, regulatory, and operational risks associated with artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including data governance, confidentiality, intellectual property ownership, and evolving AI regulatory frameworks.
    • Advise business and product teams on complex legal and regulatory matters, translating evolving requirements into practical, commercially oriented guidance.
    • Support compliance with European Union and member-state privacy, cybersecurity, and data protection requirements.
    • Provide legal analysis and guidance on regulatory matters involving agencies such as the FCC and FTC and other applicable regulatory authorities.
    • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify and mitigate legal risks while enabling new products, services, and business initiatives.
    • Help advance the legal department's use of AI and technology to improve legal drafting, contract review, regulatory analysis, and workflow efficiency.
    • Contribute to the development of responsible AI policies and internal guidelines governing the use of emerging technologies.
    • Draft, review, and negotiate complex commercial agreements and provide counsel on general corporate and business matters as needed.
    • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and proactively advise the business on their potential impact.

Qualifications

    • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with the California State Bar.
    • At least 5 years of legal experience, including in-house experience and law firm experience.
    • Strong knowledge of U.S. and international privacy and data protection laws, including GDPR, CPRA, COPPA, and PIPEDA.
    • Experience advising on complex regulatory frameworks, including matters involving the FCC, FTC, and HIPAA.
    • Demonstrated experience developing or supporting privacy, regulatory compliance, and governance programs.
    • Experience evaluating legal issues involving artificial intelligence, data governance, cybersecurity, or other emerging technologies is highly desirable.
    • Experience advising businesses in regulated industries is strongly preferred.
    • Commercial contracting experience, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating sophisticated agreements.
    • Ability to interpret complex and evolving legal requirements and translate them into clear, practical guidance for business stakeholders.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
    • Strong analytical capabilities, business judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

The ideal candidate is a business-minded, collaborative attorney who combines strong technical legal skills with sound judgment and a practical approach to problem-solving. This person will be intellectually curious, comfortable navigating evolving regulatory frameworks, and interested in the intersection of law, technology, and innovation. They will be an effective communicator who builds trusted relationships across the business, operates independently, and balances regulatory requirements with commercial objectives.

Location

This position is open to candidates residing anywhere in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $195,000–$240,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and location.

The company offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with an employer match; an employee stock purchase plan; paid time off; and additional employee benefits. Eligible employees may also receive bonus compensation and/or restricted stock units.

Compelling Career Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join an established technology company in a substantive legal role at the intersection of privacy, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies. The successful candidate will have meaningful responsibility for advising on complex legal issues, shaping privacy and governance programs, and helping the legal department leverage technology and AI to operate more effectively.

The position offers a compelling combination of sophisticated regulatory work, cross-functional business partnership, and exposure to a broad range of corporate and commercial matters within a collaborative legal team.

Job Description

Position Overview


The Professional Services Category Manager is responsible for leading Agilent’s global sourcing strategy, supplier management, and commercial governance for Professional Services and Finance categories. The portfolio includes management consulting, financial and audit consulting, key strategic transformation initiatives, outsourced services, engineering and technical services, research and development support, clinical and laboratory services, and other specialized project resources.


Operating within Global Indirect Procurement and the Corporate Services team, this role partners with senior leaders across the enterprise, including Corporate Development, the Transformation Office, Finance, Global Supply, R&D, and other corporate functions, to optimize cost, improve supplier performance, mitigate risk, and enable enterprise priorities.


The role leads highly visible, complex sourcing initiatives; shapes category direction; influences executive stakeholders across regions; and serves as a procurement subject-matter expert. Success requires exceptional influencing skills, strong stakeholder management, advanced negotiation skills, and a proven ability to deliver results.


Key Responsibilities


Global Category Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute multi-year global category strategies aligned with Agilent’s business priorities, financial objectives, and transformation agenda.
  • Develop and lead Agilent's preferred supplier strategy for professional services, including supplier segmentation, governance, performance management, and adoption across business functions.
  • Create category playbooks based on spend, supplier concentration, demand patterns, contract coverage, market dynamics, business risk, and stakeholder requirements.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities for competitive sourcing, supplier consolidation, standardization, demand management, and commercial model optimization.
  • Build and maintain a forward-looking pipeline of sourcing events, renewals, and strategic supplier initiatives.

Business Partnership & Executive Influence

  • Serve as the primary procurement advisor for Professional Services, helping senior stakeholders select appropriate sourcing strategies, suppliers, engagement models, and commercial structures.
  • Influence stakeholders to increase competitive tension, use preferred suppliers, aggregate demand, improve requirements, and adopt enterprise category strategies.
  • Present sourcing recommendations, negotiation outcomes, business cases, risks, and decisions in clear executive-level terms.
  • Facilitate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment to maximize enterprise leverage while addressing critical business needs.

Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation

  • Lead complex global and regional sourcing initiatives, including strategy development, RFPs, RFQs, supplier evaluation, negotiation, recommendation, and implementation.
  • Negotiate best-in-class commercial arrangements, including fixed-fee, milestone-based, outcome-based, managed-service, retainer, rate-card, and time-and-material models.
  • Develop fact-based negotiation strategies that balance cost, quality, flexibility, speed, innovation, and risk.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Management

  • Establish governance frameworks for strategic Professional Services suppliers, including roles, decision rights, escalation paths, KPIs, and executive review cadence.
  • Lead supplier business reviews and performance discussions focused on service quality, commercial compliance, measurable outcomes, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Implement scorecards and corrective action plans and hold suppliers accountable for contractual and operational commitments.
  • Monitor supplier, concentration, financial, operational, data, and reputational risks and coordinate mitigation plans.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or a consulting background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Professional Services, consulting, outsourcing, or other complex indirect service categories.
  • Proven success leading high-value sourcing initiatives and complex commercial negotiations in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Strong stakeholder-influencing, analytical, negotiation, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive decisions without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree, MBA, CPSM, CIPS, CPM, or an equivalent professional qualification.
  • Experience in life sciences, diagnostics, technology, or another highly regulated global industry.
  • Experience implementing preferred supplier programs, managed services, or supplier performance programs.
  • Experience with eSourcing, spend analytics, procurement reporting, and contract lifecycle management platforms.

As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Content Strategist to join our Growth Marketing Team in our Marketing department. This individual will report into our SEO Manager and own the content strategy, direction, and quality across SupplyHouse’s blog, SEO landing pages, and product detail pages (PDPs), with a focus on driving organic search growth, increasing visibility across AI-powered search platforms, and maintaining a consistent, authentic brand voice. Working closely with our Director of Growth Marketing and partners across SEO, Brand, and Product/Merchandising, this role will establish editorial standards, guide content priorities, and develop strategies that strengthen our digital presence and contribute to customer acquisition goals. If you’re passionate about creating impactful content, enjoy combining creativity with data-driven strategy, and are excited to explore new opportunities in SEO and AI-powered search, we’d love to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $77,009 to $96,261 within a full position range of $77,009 to $115,514 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a content roadmap across the blog, SEO landing pages, and PDPs that prioritizes topics by search demand, AI-citation potential, and revenue opportunity
  • Define and enforce content structure standards (headers, schema, answer-first formatting, comparison and FAQ blocks) that make content rankable in traditional search and citable by AI answer engines

  • Partner with the SEO and Growth Marketing team to translate keyword and topical-authority research into content briefs and production priorities
  • Monitor content performance across organic traffic, AI citation and visibility share, and conversion, and adjust content strategy accordingly
  • Partner with Product and Merchandising teams to ensure PDP content accurately reflects product data while remaining optimized for search and AI discovery
  • Track and adapt to evolving AI search behavior (LLM crawling, citation mechanics, answer engine optimization) to keep content practices current
  • Manage relationships with freelance writers or content vendors as needed to support production capacity without compromising brand voice

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related business field
  • 3+ years of Content Strategy, ideally in e-commerce
  • 2+ years experience writing and editing for SEO
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt tone and voice to a brand style guide
  • Experience optimizing content for AI/LLM visibility

Why work with us:

    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match

    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability

    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: !
