raw.excerpt: ABOUT ABNORMAL AIAbnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization, not just matching known signatures.
raw.description:
ABOUT ABNORMAL AI

Abnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization, not just matching known signatures. That approach started with email, where we protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500. It's the same behavioral AI, built over eight years, that now powers our new AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. We're launching new products faster than at any point in our history, and this role sits right at the center of that expansion.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite. One Specialist sits in each sales pod, working alongside the pod's Account Executives to bring deep sales and product expertise to AI Security conversations. This is a sales role, built for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. If you want to be at the center of one of the fastest-moving new product lines in cybersecurity, with the technical range to earn trust at every level of a customer's organization, this is that role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Carry a dedicated quota for the AI Security suite, separate from your pod's core quota.
  • Partner with Account Executives across your pod to identify, qualify, and advance AI Security opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
  • Go deep on the technical substance of behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when customers need more than a standard pitch, credibly holding your own with security and platform teams.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, partnering closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Help build the playbook for how AI Security gets sold as this suite matures from early availability into GA. Much of this motion is still being defined, and you'll have real influence over how it takes shape.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly as products move from design partner to GA.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

Product

Description

AI Governance

Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.

AI Cloud Security

Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

AI Employee Guardrails

Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

AI Agent Security

Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.

AI Security Workbench

Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

AI security is coming up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust Abnormal's behavioral approach to solve it. Every security vendor is staking a claim in this space, but Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a proven track record protecting email for thousands of customers.

That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure Abnormal capitalizes on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means getting in early on a brand-new motion, working closely with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of Enterprise sales experience (3,000+ seat accounts), with a proven track record of winning new logos, expanding accounts, and displacing legacy competitors in competitive markets.
  • Genuine technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity. This suite and the motion for selling it are both still evolving, and much of the playbook will be built by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. This role depends on tight partnership with AEs, Sales Engineering, and product leadership rather than working in isolation.
  • Prior exposure to cybersecurity, AI/ML concepts, or cloud security.

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

raw.description:
Our mission at Talkspace is to lower the barriers to mental healthcare. A critical piece to ensuring that everyone has access to therapy is partnering closely with the healthcare payer ecosystem to help our members get the care they need. Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Client Support Supervisor to join our Client Support team. This role would be responsible for leading and developing a team of client support representatives, ensuring their success from their first day at Talkspace through their entire journey. This includes assessing their work, providing feedback, and driving performance and quality to achieve outlined success metrics. We are looking for someone who has experience developing a team and wants to bring their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us to achieve our mission of bringing quality mental healthcare to all.

*This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC*

What You'll Do

Supervisor responsibilities

    • Lead and develop a team of client support representatives from their first day at Talkspace through their last, ensuring the achievement of all outlined success metrics by frequently assessing their work and providing feedback aimed to maximize performance and quality.
    • Conduct 1:1 meetings and performance reviews with direct reports to help motivate them in their daily workload, while also driving team morale, and fostering career development.
    • Staff departmental specialty projects based on required skill set per focus area and volume needs; oversee the execution of duties + conduct periodic analysis of project effectiveness.
    • Report on your micro team’s production and quality performance on a weekly basis, noting trends and discussing required action plans for performance improvement.
    • Monitor departmental staffing levels through scheduling + gameplan mapping, suggest changes to help support daily operations, as needed.
    • Participate in the implementation of department performance metric targeting; work with key stakeholders to refine SLAs as business goals shift.
    • Design and execute corrective action plans for representatives not achieving outlined performance and quality metrics.
    • Participate in hiring of support representatives and assist new hires to ramp to production within outlined timeframes.
    • Execute weekly payroll responsibilities.
    • Participate in leadership training, as assigned.

Tools

    • Actively monitor all CRM ticket inboxes/queues to ensure teams are meeting required first response times.
    • Effectively manage all leadership CRM inboxes/queues, directing and answering tickets, as needed.
    • Work closely with department leadership on strategies to maintain queues, assigning representatives where needed, to prevent increases to backlog.
    • Optimize internal use of QA software to record outcomes of coaching conversations for posterity and stakeholder visibility.
    • Assist client support sta with duties where required.

Department Optimization

    • Maintain advanced working knowledge of departmental policies, procedures, and voice of our customer (VOC).
    • Assist support representatives to investigate client reports of service interruptions, partner with internal teams on a resolution and communicate to support representatives to quickly resolve customer service complaints.
    • Assist with the development and implementation of company service policies and updates, draft documentation pertaining to customer service department activities, as needed.
    • Identify ongoing trends seen within client outreach and recommend enhancements to departmental policy, procedure, and company tools + resources, as needed.
    • Work with representatives to develop pathways for surfacing trends seen within client inquiries, opportunities for process improvement, and recommend ideas to improve SOPs.

Collaboration

    • Participate in interdepartmental meetings, providing insight into our end user and client support representative experience, as needed.
    • Partner with department Specialists/Leads to resolve escalated support tickets.
    • Initiate cross-departmental communication and coordinate to escalate and resolve customer issues.
    • Partner with Training, Quality + Content teams to ensure our knowledge materials + resources are adequate and allow staff to meet outlined performance expectations and service excellence standards.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university.
  • At least 2+ years direct experience managing and developing contact center support representatives, preferably in a telehealth environment.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Atlassian (Confluence, Jira), Stripe, and Looker, a plus.
  • Outstanding computer and technology skills.
  • Superb organizational and project management skills.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proven people leadership skills (coaching, staffing, planning).
  • Strong decision-making and process improvement skills.
  • Self-starter, able to work independently and prioritize effectively.
  • Excellent time management skill; strong sense of urgency.
  • Experience managing and developing standard operating procedures.
  • Passion for delivering a phenomenal customer experience!
  • Strong internet connection, required.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge or experience with telehealth, telemedicine, or health plans
  • Experience (or strong interest) in working in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with third parties/vendor management

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage since day one
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $65,000.00 and $72,500.00. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the most comprehensive and convenient way to take care of your mental health and wellness , focused on providing quality mental health services on your own terms.

Our signature psychotherapy and psychiatry product connects individual users with a network of thousands of licensed mental health providers through an easy-to-use and HIPAA-compliant web and mobile platform. With Talkspace, users can connect their dedicated provider via live video, text, or phone.

Our focus to help people feel better starts at Talkspace, where we connect and collaborate as a team to make the world a better place. Fun company-wide events, happy hours, wellness perks, flex PTO, access to Talkspace products, and competitive benefits are just some of the ways we make Talkspace a great place to work. Do you want to save the world? Come join us!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification, if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Epic Kids is the leading digital reading platform built for kids 12 and under, trusted by millions of children, educators, and families around the world. Our mission is to inspire a lifelong love of reading by providing unlimited access to thousands of high-quality books, videos, and educational content through a safe and engaging experience. We combine technology, storytelling, and learning innovation to help every child become a confident reader.

At Epic, you'll join a collaborative and fast-paced global team passionate about building meaningful products that make a real impact on children's education and literacy.

About the Role

TheSenior Software Engineer, Full-Stackowns features end-to-end across Epic's web application -- Angular front-end, PHP/Symfony and Go services, MySQL -- and helps raise the engineering bar for the team. We hire for engineering strength over experience with any specific stack; strong engineers ramp quickly on ours.

This is a fully remote, US-based role working closely with a global engineering team with members in the US and China.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship features end-to-end across the full stack, from spec to production.
  • Make sound decisions on architecture, data modeling, and API design; document trade-offs and align stakeholders.
  • Drive code quality through code review and testing across front-end and back-end.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code review and pairing.
  • Lead technical design reviews, RFCs, and architecture discussions.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, holding generated code to the same quality bar.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, owning complex, cross-team work autonomously.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong front-end engineering with a modern component framework (Angular a plus), plus solid TypeScript/JavaScript and UI fundamentals (HTML, CSS, accessibility).
  • Strong back-end engineering in a modern server-side language (we use PHP and Go).
  • Relational-database proficiency -- data modeling, performant queries, and indexing.
  • Experience designing and operating production APIs (REST or gRPC).

Preferred Qualifications

Reporting directly to the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Innovation (CMMI) Program Manager, the Program Specialist will be a pivotal contributor to the operational excellence and strategic growth of our CMMI initiatives. This role is responsible for the intricate management and refinement of core program processes, ensuring seamless execution across all facets of CMMI models (LEAD & REACH). The Specialist will play a key role in analyzing program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization, and collaborating with diverse internal teams to implement innovative solutions that enhance engagement and outcomes within the CMMI model framework. This position is central to translating strategic vision into operational reality, driving the continuous improvement and successful scaling of CMMI models.
Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones.

Primary Duties

    Working and supporting day-to-day ACO REACH & LEAD processes and operations:
  • Manage Zendesk incoming/outgoing communications for the CMMI team, responsible for all Zendesk tickets, escalating tickets as needed to the appropriate person/team
  • Find and build out solutions in Monday.com for any CMMI process and operations needs (Growth, SVA, Contacts, Practice lists, Provider lists, CMS tickets, etc.)
  • Utilize Medicare reports from 4i (quality, financial, claims reduction files, SVA response files) to generate reports so actionable insights and opportunities for improvement can be identified
  • Utilize reports, calendars, and internal tools (Tableau, Snowflake) to build out internal and external decks for Contract and Resource Meetings and Performance and Resource Meetings
  • Utilize insights, opportunities, and calendars to draft and maintain the Aledade LEAD newsletter and its distribution list
  • Manage the Beneficiary Zoom Voicemail for the CMMI team, ensuring that beneficiary questions are answered and logged for tracking and documentation purposes in Monday.com
    • Serve as a trusted planner, organizer, and executor for the CMMI team:
  • Plan in Monday.com based on the CMMI programs calendar distributed by CMS so all deadlines are scheduled and met, both internally and externally
  • Maintain CMMI programs Google Drive folders, prioritizing organization and appropriate access
  • Act as a thought partner in opportunities for CMMI process development, needs, or gaps
  • Provide suggestions and recommendations to ambiguous problems that align with program goals
  • Think critically and move work forward without clearly defined or outlined next steps
    • Act as a researcher and advisor for the CMMI team's special projects and cross-functional initiatives:
  • Contribute to broader, interdepartmental projects and meetings, including Field Team trainings, support, and inbound questions, as well as Project Turnkey support and coordination
  • Communicate statuses on operations and keep stakeholders informed on any progress and roadblocks
  • Develop implementation plans, communications, and rollout of approved necessary BE/BEIs (Telehealth)
  • Provide details and insights during CMMI team meetings based on the CMS ACO LEAD newsletter, with emphasis on communicating when reports and funds are expected to be released, upcoming changes within the program, and important deadlines
  • Serve as a resource to the PTS team to assist in addressing practice needs tied to CMMI operations

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
  • 3+ years of progressive healthcare experience
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
  • Familiar with project management tools such as Monday.com
  • Experience in data analytics using Excel or Google Sheets
  • Willingness to travel as needed to Aledade’s headquarters and other offsite meetings (less than 10% across the year anticipated)

Preferred KSA's:

  • Knowledge of CMS VBC programs
  • Can effectively adapt communication style based on audience needs
  • Frequently and effectively collaborates cross functionally
  • Exceptional written and verbal communications skills
  • Snowflake experience
  • Tableau experience
  • Self-starter with strong interpersonal skills
  • Proven ability to coordinate and facilitate new ideas into action while collaborating across multiple, dynamic, projects and teams

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. ABOUT WIZARDTALES

Wizardtales Private Limited works in cloud infrastructure and IT services, bringing together technical expertise and international collaboration to deliver dependable services for our customers.

Our supportive, collaborative culture reflects the German work ethics we value: reliability, punctuality, clear communication, quality and keeping our commitments. We believe ambitious work and a healthy work-life balance belong together.

We offer the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and grow your responsibilities as the business develops.

YOUR ROLE

You will connect our German-speaking customers with our technical team, ensuring that requests are understood, priorities are clear and commitments are met.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys service delivery, takes responsibility and follows through without needing constant reminders.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicate confidently with customers in German through calls, meetings, emails and ticket updates.
  • Make sure every ticket has an owner, a priority and clear next steps, and follow through until resolution.
  • Coordinate engineers and colleagues, clarify responsibilities and help remove blockers.
  • Prioritize urgent incidents, customer commitments and planned work according to impact and available capacity.
  • Identify delays and risks early, manage escalations and keep customers informed.
  • Improve workflows, documentation and communication to make service delivery more reliable.
  • Give management concise updates on progress, outstanding issues and decisions requiring attention.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A minimum of five years of relevant industry experience in IT services, managed services, cloud infrastructure or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing customer-facing service delivery and coordinating technical teams.
  • Fluent spoken and written German, supported by a German language certificate.
  • Strong English communication skills for working with the wider team.
  • Experience with ticketing systems, incident management, service commitments and customer escalations.
  • Enough technical understanding to discuss IT issues confidently and coordinate effectively with engineers.
  • Strong organization, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.
  • The ability to work independently and communicate proactively in a remote environment.

Experience supporting German-speaking customers and familiarity with ITIL practices would be an advantage.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fully remote work from India.
  • A respectful, supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • An international working environment with German-speaking customers and colleagues.
  • Trust, ownership and the opportunity to influence how we work.
  • A commitment to healthy work-life balance, realistic planning and sustainable workloads.
  • Opportunities to learn, develop professionally and grow your responsibilities with the business.

Location: Remote, New York, San Francisco and Bangalore

Mode of Work: Remote, Hybrid

Company Overview: A leading product-based company, it specializes in AI-driven marketing solutions, offering innovative tools for enhanced brand visibility and customer engagement. Their advanced technology leverages cross-platform advertising, contextual targeting, and precise audience insights to drive effective marketing campaigns. Recognized for its cutting-edge solutions, the company helps brands achieve significant reach and impact in a competitive digital landscape. Its commitment to technological excellence and customer success positions it as a key player in the marketing technology industry.

Job Description:

We are seeking an innovative Product Manager to lead the development and lifecycle management of products. This role involves driving product strategy, overseeing development from ideation through launch, and ensuring the products meet market needs and exceed customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.

  • Assess market competition by comparing the company's product to competitors' products.

  • Conduct market research and customer feedback analysis to inform product strategy.

  • Provide source data for product line communications by defining product marketing communication objectives.

  • Bring new products to market by analyzing proposed product requirements and development programs, preparing return-on-investment analyses, and establishing time schedules with engineering.

  • Introduce and market new products by developing time-integrated plans with sales, advertising, and production.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define product release requirements and oversee development.

  • Develop pricing strategies and ensure product profitability.

  • Monitor and measure product performance to inform future product enhancements.

  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver products on time and within budget.

Knowledge:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of product lifecycle management, market analysis, and product development processes.

Experience Level:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in product management, preferably in a product based technology-driven company.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven ability to strategize and implement high-level program initiatives.

  • Ability to work closely with engineering teams to define product release requirements and oversee product development.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working across cross-functional teams to deliver on product goals.

  • Proficiency in Agile methodologies, CRM tools, and software like Jira and Salesforce.

  • Experience with market research, data analysis, and deployment of products that align with business goals.

Attitude:

  • Proactive leadership and a passion for product development and management.

  • Creative thinker with a customer-first mentality.

  • Highly adaptable and open to learning new technologies and methodologies.

Qualifications:

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.

  • Extensive experience in product management, preferably within software or technology sectors.

  • Certifications in Agile, Scrum, or Product Management are highly desirable.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

  • Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies.

  • Flexible working conditions and a supportive work environment.

Diversity Policy:

Committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity of thoughts, experience, and background.

Career Growth:

Continuous career development opportunities with pathways for advancement in a growing company. Support for ongoing education and professional training.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

raw.title: GenAI Algorithms Intern – Model Optimization for Inference
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution!
raw.description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution! The Algorithmic Model Optimization Team focuses on optimizing generative AI models such as large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and diffusion models for maximal inference efficiency using techniques ranging from quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning to neural architecture search, and automated deployment strategies.

Our work includes conducting applied research to improve model efficiency as well as developing an innovative open-source model optimization platform (NVIDIA Model Optimizer). Our software is used both internally across NVIDIA and externally by research and engineering teams alike developing best-in-class AI models.

We are seeking a GenAI Algorithms Intern to help optimize state-of-the-art generative AI models like LLMs, VLMs, multimodal and diffusion models. In this role, you will design, implement, and productionize model optimization algorithms for inference and deployment on NVIDIA’s latest hardware platforms. The focus is on ease of use, compute and memory efficiency, and achieving the best accuracy–performance tradeoffs through software–hardware co-design.

Your work will span multiple layers of the AI software stack—ranging from algorithm design to integration—within NVIDIA’s ecosystem (Model Optimizer, NeMo/Megatron, TensorRT-LLM) and open-source frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang). You may also dive deeper into GPU-level optimization, including custom kernel development with CUDA and Triton.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Help design and build modular, scalable model optimization software platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences while supporting diverse AI models and optimization techniques.
  • Explore, develop, and integrate innovative deep learning optimization algorithms (quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search) into NVIDIA's AI software stack.
  • Deploy optimized models into leading open-source inference frameworks and contribute specialized APIs, model-level optimizations, and new features tailored to the latest NVIDIA hardware capabilities.
  • Collaborate with NVIDIA teams on model optimization solutions for customer use cases, aiming for optimal end-to-end workflows and balanced accuracy–performance trade-offs.
  • Conduct GPU kernel-level profiling to identify and capitalize on hardware and software optimization opportunities (e.g., efficient attention kernels, KV cache optimization, parallelism strategies).

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
  • Strong deep learning background and hands-on experience with language models.
  • Solid foundation in algorithms and programming.
  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and modern ML frameworks/tools.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with model optimization and efficiency (e.g., quantization, distillation, pruning).
  • Contributions to PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, or other machine learning training and inference frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning generative AI models on large-scale GPU clusters.
  • Knowledge of GPU architectures and compilation stacks, and the ability to analyze and debug end-to-end performance.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s deep learning SDKs (Model Optimizer, NeMo).

Increasingly known as “the AI computing company” and widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Are you creative, motivated, and love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our model optimization group, where you can help build real-time, cost-effective computing platforms driving our success in this exciting and rapidly-growing field.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Our internship pay is based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. For Poland: the annual range for our interns is 117,750 PLN - 204,100 PLN. (pro-rated for the duration of the internship).

description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Germany | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Bonus Points For:

  • Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
  • Experience working with OSS communities
  • Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
  • Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €97,034 - €116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
raw.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $210,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Translate customer or market needs and high-level ideas into product decisions, clear specifications, acceptance criteria, and achievable weekly delivery goals.
  • Own architecture and implementation of Elixir-based applications, including integrations, APIs, data models, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Set up and operate autonomous coding-agent workflows: plan tasks, run parallel agents where useful, preserve context and state, recover failed or interrupted work, and manage execution cost and limits.
  • Build a dependable delivery loop from specification/PRD to tracked issues, agent implementation, automated tests, CI, independent QA/security review, pull requests, and controlled merges and releases.
  • Use engineering judgment to challenge agent output, diagnose difficult problems, validate behavior end-to-end, and prevent regressions; write code directly when it is the best way to solve a problem.
  • Communicate daily and proactively with the client and team: surface risks early, propose trade-offs and solutions, demonstrate working increments, and maintain visible progress without waiting for instructions.
  • Continuously improve the agent harness, development standards, observability, and quality gates so the workflow becomes faster, safer, and less dependent on manual supervision.

What success looks like

  • Each sprint ends with working, verified software the client can see.
  • Agents make progress on prepared work between your reviews.
  • Fast delivery that holds up on quality and security.

Minimum qualifications (must have)

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience delivering and maintaining production applications, with strong debugging, architecture, and software-design fundamentals.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Elixir development experience on real applications; ability to reason confidently about Elixir code and its runtime. Phoenix, OTP, and Ecto experience are highly relevant.
  • Demonstrable experience shipping meaningful development work using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or comparable CLI-based tools, beyond basic code completion.
  • Ability to operate multi-step agent workflows with testing, review, retries, and human approval gates; ownership of the correctness and security of shipped results.
  • Strong full-stack or backend engineering skills: APIs, databases, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-hosted production systems.
  • Product mindset and independent judgment: able to understand users, prioritize useful outcomes, make architecture trade-offs, and deliver with minimal direction.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, proactive client communication, and ability to work remotely with your own equipment during 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time.

Additional desired qualifications

  • An existing autonomous “software factory” or agent harness you can demonstrate, including issue orchestration, isolated workspaces, QA/review agents, and persistent execution state.
  • Experience with AWS, JavaScript/TypeScript or Node.js, and modern DevOps and observability practices.
  • Experience designing developer-first integrations, SDKs, CLIs, MCP tools, or plugin-based platforms; production mobile application experience is a plus.

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.
  • Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.
  • Identify ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and coordinate resolution with engineering stakeholders.

SCADE & Software Development Support

  • Utilize SCADE within model-based software development and verification environments.
  • Support verification of SCADE generated or model-based avionics software.
  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.
  • Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.
  • Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.
  • Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.
  • Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.
  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.
  • Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.
  • Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.
  • Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience.
  • Minimum five years of Java development experience.
  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
  • Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.
  • Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.
  • Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.
  • Experience with test automation.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.
  • Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools.
  • Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.
  • Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.
  • Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is remote and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Travel of up to 10% may be required to support program activities, technical reviews, integration, testing, or customer needs.

The position requires close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, certification, and program engineering teams.

Compensation

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer: $100,000 to $150,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors.

Benefits

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) with Company Match

• Company Paid Life Insurance

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Employee Assistance Program

• Professional Development Opportunities

About Crown

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Role:

Fullscript is how thousands of healthcare providers deliver better care to their patients, and paid digital is one of our biggest growth levers. As Senior Digital Marketing Specialist, you’ll oversee paid strategy across search, social, and programmatic, manage a large budget, and have a dedicated experimentation budget to find the channels and tactics that will drive our next stage of growth. You’ll work with a high-performing agency and a small in-house team, with the autonomy to shape how Fullscript reaches new providers online.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and strategic marketing leader who can balance hands-on campaign management with long-term strategic vision. You will shape Fullscript’s paid digital approach, mentor a growing team, and continuously evolve how Fullscript connects with healthcare providers online.

What You’ll Do:

  • Paid Digital Strategy: Includes Paid Search, including Google’s AI-driven formats (PMax, AI Max) and automated bidding, with the judgment to know when to lean into automation and when to take back control. Social, and Programmatic.Strategically drive planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns across platforms, focusing on customer acquisition. Ensure cohesive strategy across all channels.

  • Campaign Management: While hands-on execution is managed by our agency, this role will be expected to optimize, and troubleshoot digital campaigns across the marketing funnel. Leverage market-leading DSPs, Meta, Google Ads, and Microsoft Ads to achieve Fullscript’s growth goals.

  • Test & Learn: Own a dedicated experimentation budget to pilot new channels, tactics, and formats, such as healthcare networks, CTV, LinkedIn, or emerging AI-driven ad products. Design tests with clear hypotheses and success criteria, and make the call on what scales and what gets cut.

  • Data Analysis & Insights: Own how we measure paid performance, using incrementality testing, first-party data, and offline conversion tracking to optimize toward qualified providers and revenue, not just leads. Navigate signal loss and healthcare advertising restrictions, and turn large data sets into clear recommendations that drive efficiency and ROI.

  • Team Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with internal teams including marketing, creative, and data, while also managing external partners. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, ensuring the effective execution of campaigns.

  • Client & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners, and cross functional stakeholders. Collaborate on strategy and planning for campaigns as part of Fullscript’s broader marketing mix.

  • Process Improvement: Actively contribute to the development and enhancement of Fullscript’s paid digital capabilities, using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, and creative iteration. Identify and implement process improvements to automate and streamline workflow to ensure efficient high-quality campaign delivery.

  • Budget Management: Oversee your portion of the paid digital budget management, including spend delivery, invoicing, investment, and forecast tracking. Help drive profitability within the department while ensuring campaign efficiency and performance.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years experience in paid digital campaign management, with hands-on experience using Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, DSPs, and other ad-serving platforms.

  • Experience in managing $5 million+ in annual paid budgets.

  • Strong knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, focused on the US and Canadian Healthcare market, with an emphasis on paid search, paid social, programmatic display, and their roles in customer engagement.

  • A sharp eye for performance copy, with experience writing and testing ad messaging that drives clicks and conversions.

  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and Slides to be able to turn complex performance data into a clear story and recommendations for leadership.

  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to work with large data sets and derive actionable insights.

  • Detail-oriented with a high degree of numeracy and literacy to manage complex campaigns and deliver results.

  • Strong communication skills, able to work cross-functionally, and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience managing commercial aspects of digital campaigns, including budgeting, invoicing, and margin management.

    • Bonus Points:

  • Healthcare B2B and B2C experience.

  • Experience and frameworks to apply with A/B testing to refine campaigns and improve results.

  • Familiarity with performance tracking tools like Google Analytics and Looker Studio to evaluate paid digital program performance.

  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies for a multi-product platform serving both SMB and Enterprise customers

Compensation Range:

    The salary range for this role is between $90 000 and $120 000 [CAD]. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

    Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

    Additionally:

    ⬦ Flexible PTO & competitive pay – Because work-life balance matters.
    ⬦ RRSP/401k match – Invest in your future.
    ⬦ Premium benefits package – Customizable coverage, paramedical services, and HSA.
    ⬦ Fullscript discounts – Save on high-quality wellness products.
    ⬦ Continuous learning opportunities – Training budgets and company-wide initiatives.
    ⬦ Hybrid & remote work flexibility – Your office, your way.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.
