The Director, Business and Process Optimization serves as a key member of the leadership team, providing strategic leadership in the direction and execution of the operations and resourcing for the department in a complex cross-functional environment to develop and execute strategies that ensure continuous process improvement and optimize organizational performance, processes, and associated systems, training and communications in order to achieve business goals and objectives.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides management & strategic direction to the business operation/corporate function.
  • Participates with senior leadership in developing and authorizing the implementation of strategic business plans.
  • Oversees a portfolio of cross-functional activities, projects and initiatives delivering strategic insights, analyses and recommendations to drive continuous process improvement and assess compliance with cross-functional processes and associated systems/applications, training and communications.
  • Serves as business lead for large, complex, cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborates, innovates and consults with multiple stakeholders, peers and leaders to drive strategy, execution and communications planning to achieve continuous process improvement and departmental and organizational business imperatives, goals and objectives
  • Oversees initiatives to develop, optimize, improve and assess compliance with cross functional processes and associated systems/applications, training and communications.
  • Provides administrative oversight of the department, including staffing, budgeting, scheduling and long term planning. Provides strategic direction to staff through line management of a team. Accountable for effective recruitment, induction, talent development and retention of staff. Provides ongoing coaching and feedback including formal performance appraisals, development plans and career coaching.
  • Develops and implements business plans, forecasting and proactively supports and drives process and systems optimization activities.
  • May provide oversight and/or responses for client or internal process audits on processes, systems, or procedures and/or CAPAs.
  • Cultivates an environment of continuous improvement
  • Acts as an internal transformation consultant in overseeing M&A integration activities
  • Life science graduate, pharmacy, nursing, other healthcare related qualification or experience in pharmacovigilance
  • Extensive pharmacovigilance experience with experience of process improvement, safety applications and systems including demonstrated line management experience
  • Extensive leadership experience in PV from a service provider environment
  • Experience optimizing processes and managing through to implementation
  • Outstanding leadership and management skills
  • Advanced skill in process development and improvement, especially as it applies to clinical and post-marketing PV
  • Excellent project management skills
  • Certification in process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma is a plus
  • Superior attention to detail, investigative and analytical skills
  • Outstanding interpersonal, negotiation and problem solving skills
  • Superior computer skills, to include an effective understanding of clinical management and pharmacovigilance technology and systems
  • Expert understanding of the practices, processes and requirements of clinical trials, to include regulatory guidelines and directives
  • Superior oral and written communication skills including the ability to communicate in English, both orally and in writing
  • Capable of directing and promoting teamwork in a multidisciplinary and/or multi-cultural team setting
  • Capable of driving innovation in developing new ideas related to process improvements
  • Outstanding organizational, judgment, analytical, decision making and interpersonal skills to manage complex projects in parallel and manage rapidly changing priorities

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.

We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.

That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

raw.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

At The Home Depot, we get UX; it is baked into our DNA. Now we are expanding our team to drive new initiatives. As a member of the UX team, you will work with other strategists, designers, and researchers to help craft end-to-end experiences and identify customer needs.

You are a designer with a desire to solve interesting and meaty customer problems. Whether it's using design thinking techniques to drive ideation and alignment or bringing a paper prototype to your user for a quick experiment, you can identify and execute the right steps towards solving a problem. You recognize the value of well-crafted design along with the value of imagination and play in building great products within a business environment.

With passion for good interaction and visual design, you can craft end-to-end experiences to enact cutting-edge retail strategies; balancing user needs with business strategy and ultimately creating delight for your customers. You love to work hand in hand with your users to build a more effective and efficient experience for them. You might not consider yourself a researcher, but you have solid awareness of research best practices and know that research is the foundation towards good design. You can also use evaluative approaches to iteratively improve your products.

You appreciate feedback and support from fellow researchers, designers, engineers, analysts, or product managers in our cross functional environment. You enjoy collaborative effort, taking feedback and input to your UX activities as a means of improving the end result. You are as comfortable influencing business leadership as you are your product leadership and individual contributors. You are the customer and user advocate. You drive innovation by championing actionable user insights, deeply understanding our customers, enhancing product usability, and providing our team avenues to delight our customers. You communicate effectively and share a point of view that guides quality decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 15% - Coaching and Mentoring - Leads interview exercises, determine cultural and team fits of candidates and aligns needs of the organization. Helps UX Leadership align resources to products based on skillset and cultural fit. Coaches junior resources in UX activities and mentors UX resources for career development.
  • 45% - Delivery & Execution - Provides UX design artifacts, and tests usability of their assigned product. Leads data collection and synthesis. Drives delivery in product area. Oversees delivery of other designers.
  • 40% - Leads Planning and Strategy Activities to Align Design Patterns and Testing Methods - Clearly communicates & drives value of UX within the experience. Displays situational adaptability, is able to step in and drive change in products to better align with user needs or organizational goals. Has courage and organizational savvy to drive this change. Drives UX practice across experience, domain, or group of products. Partners with Product, Development, other UX resources and business stakeholders across products to align multiple experiences in a domain. Drives vision and purpose; Combines user research outputs with OGSMs of partners to clearly articulate the vision of their experience and drive alignment with partners in solutions across products and experiences.

  • Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.

Working Conditions:

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

  • 7-9 years of UX experience in an Enterprise or retail environment or a degree in related field
  • 7-9 years of experience working with agile software development teams
  • Desire to thrive in a fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to initiate and self-manage complex projects
  • Experience bringing together multiple efforts into a cohesive end-to-end experience
  • Help with consistency and quality control across design work
  • Teach/Lead/Mentor junior contributors

  • Provide back up and additional mentorship support to Manager as necessary

About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

About Intelligems

There are millions of e-commerce businesses around the world, and the industry is growing every year. Yet achieving profitability has never been harder. Most brands make guesses when it comes to pricing, discounts, shipping fees, and content — leaving 6–10% of potential profit on the table.

Intelligems is a profit optimization platform that helps these businesses succeed. We provide merchants with A/B testing and personalization tools that help them run experiments, understand their data, and price dynamically — tools that were previously only available to companies like Amazon and Uber.

We're currently working with 500+ brands and have processed over $4B of data. Backed by Matchstick Ventures, Vinyl Capital, Techstars, and founders from Klaviyo, Postscript, and Stedi, Intelligems has raised over $4M in funding. Our team is high-performing, low-ego, and extremely collaborative — and we’re excited to scale with top talent.

The Role: Technical Support Engineer

We’re looking for a Technical Support Engineer to help our e-commerce clients understand, utilize, and troubleshoot our testing platform. You'll report to the Support & Implementation Manager and communicate with customers daily via email, Slack, and chat to resolve issues and deliver an outstanding customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver a best-in-class customer experience by responding promptly to customer inquiries

  • Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and offer solutions or escalate when needed

  • Become a product expert so you can answer questions quickly and accurately

  • Manage 20–30 open customer conversations at a time

  • Own follow-ups and ensure all tickets are resolved in a timely manner

  • Collaborate with internal teams on escalated or complex issues

  • Spot trends in support issues and share insights with product, tech, and ops

  • Contribute to internal knowledge-sharing (documentation, training, etc.)

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in technical/customer/merchant support or a related role

  • Experience in e-commerce (Shopify), SaaS, or analytics

  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

  • You love helping people and can think on your feet

  • Comfortable wearing many hats and juggling priorities

  • Ability to multitask, stay organized, and manage time effectively

  • Familiarity with tools like Tableau, Looker, SQL, or BI platforms is a bonus

  • Comfortable with providing weekend support

Culture & Values

At Intelligems, we’re customer-first and product-oriented — and our success is driven by the caliber of people we bring on board. We live by these values:

  1. Put customers first

    • Be honest and transparent. Always act in the customer’s best interest.

  2. Be helpful

    • Support teammates, customers, and partners with generosity and kindness.

  3. Strive for excellence

    • Commit to being world-class at what you do.

  4. Build and develop a diverse, world-class team

    • Hire the best, and invest in feedback and growth.

  5. Have a perspective

    • Speak up when you disagree. Everyone is responsible for making us better.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Celebrating 40+ years!

Theradex Oncology is a full-service CRO specializing in oncology. The company manages global oncology trials and programs. The company was founded in 1982 working with the National Cancer Institute, which led to its expansion to working with industry sponsors developing cancer therapeutics. As a service-based company we support both domestic and international sponsors in the conduct of both early and late phase trials.

What You'll Do

As part of Theradex Oncology, you will have the opportunity to work with one of the largest professional teams focused solely on the development of cancer therapies. Cancer research continues to evolve as new therapies and therapeutic approaches are discovered, as part of the team you will work to support our sponsors in the development of these therapies. Theradex Oncology is an environment for highly motivated individuals who want to make a difference.

We are hiring a Full time, Site Payment Analyst (Freelance/Temporary Contractor) either based in UK, Spain or Bulgaria on a 6- 12 months contract (Home Based).

The Site Payment Analyst will be responsible for the administration, tracking and reconciliation of investigator site payments across assigned clinical studies. The role supports study teams by ensuring site invoices are accurately reviewed, logged, tracked and processed in accordance with Clinical Trial Agreements, study budgets and company procedures. The Site Payment Associate acts as the primary coordinator for site payment administration and maintains accurate payment records to support financial oversight, reporting and study reconciliation activities.

The primary responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Site Payment Administration
    • Receive, review and log investigator site invoices and payment requests.
    • Verify invoices against executed Clinical Trial Agreements, approved budgets and study payment schedules.
    • Maintain accurate records of invoices received, approved, paid and outstanding.
    • Track payment status and ensure payment requests are progressed in accordance with study timelines.
    • Follow up with investigator sites regarding missing, incomplete or duplicate invoices.
    • Support the resolution of invoice queries and payment discrepancies.
  • Payment Tracking and Reconciliation
    • Maintain study-specific payment trackers and payment logs.
    • Record invoice numbers, payment references and payment status.
    • Reconcile invoiced amounts against study activity, contractual obligations and payment records.
    • Assist with the identification of overpayments, underpayments and duplicate billings.
    • Support study close-out payment reconciliation activities.
  • Study and Financial Support
    • Review study reports, EDC data and supporting documentation to confirm invoiced activities where required.
    • Assist with tracking site startup fees and recurring site costs.
    • Generate payment status reports for study teams and management.
    • Support accrual tracking and financial reporting activities as required.
  • Stakeholder Communication
    • Act as a point of contact for investigator sites regarding payment-related queries.
    • Liaise with Clinical Research Associates, Project Managers, Contracts and Finance teams to resolve payment issues.
    • Escalate complex payment discrepancies, contractual issues or financial risks to management.
  • Compliance and Quality
    • Ensure payment documentation is complete, accurate and audit ready.
    • Follow company SOPs, study-specific procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
    • Participate in quality reviews and process improvement initiatives related to site payment administration.

What You Need

Qualifications and Experience

  • Essential
    • Degree or equivalent experience in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Finance or a related discipline.
    • 2+ years prior relevant experience in a CRO, pharmaceutical/drug R&D environment, laboratory/clinical supply vendors, imaging vendors or hospital/pharmacy systems. (Required)
    • Understanding of Clinical Trial Agreements and site budgets.(Required)
    • Familiarity with CTMS, EDC systems or financial management tools.(Required)
    • Electronic data capture (EDC) systems.(Required)
    • Prior grant payment system experience required - Greenphire /Medidata or similar clinical trial site payment platform.
  • Preferred
    • Previous administrative experience within clinical research, finance or project support.
    • Experience reviewing invoices or supporting financial reconciliation activities.
    • Experience working with spreadsheets and data tracking tools.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Familiarity with PowerBi, Power Automate, PowerApps
  • Key Competencies
    • Strong attention to detail.
    • Excellent organisational and time management skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
    • Analytical and problem-solving mindset.
    • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a global team.

This job does not offer company sponsorship Theradex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment.

Position Overview

Power your future with Qualus as a Senior Electrical Engineer, to join our Commerical & Industrial team to support the design of complex and large power systems, relay upgrades and modifications, and life-extension projects that power communities and critical infrastructure. This role offers long-term workload stability, exposure to a diverse portfolio of projects, and the opportunity to provide technical leadership across multiple clients.

You will act on behalf of the project owner to bridget knowledge gaps, oversee quality, and provide technical leadership across all phases of project execution, from concept development through detailed design, construction, and commissioning. This opportunity is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys technical ownership, mentoring others, and solving complex system-level challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Medium and low voltage electrical design consisting of, but not limited to: Outdoor substations, unit substations, power transformers, protection and control schemes, power monitoring, circuit breaker replacements, relay replacements, brownfield and greenfield EPC projects.
  • Specification development for medium and low voltage electrical equipment.
  • Works with CAD staff to develop and/or update client electrical drawings including one lines, wiring diagrams, and schematics.
  • Reviews field data and performs coordination, short circuit, and arc flash studies.
  • Review power monitoring data to provide customer recommendations.
  • Act as a representative of Qualus to support sales in customer site walks.
  • Leads interaction with other functions and locations to determine optimum solutions.
  • Remains current on all safety and technical training.
  • Adheres to all company, industry and client safety protocols and standards.
  • Assesses project specific resource needs and coordinates assignments with project manager.
  • Communicates core technical job requirements.
  • Supports immediate supervisor on planning and organizing workload to ensure the most effective return on assets.
  • Coordinates proper project hand-off between sales and operations/engineering.
  • Participates in project kickoff meetings to discuss work scope, project specifications, budgets, schedules, and safety requirements with project team.
  • Effectively communicates with other departments to assure activities are properly coordinated.
  • Ensures timely and accurate invoicing for all engineering projects by providing all paperwork in a like manner; these include Service Acknowledgement Forms (SAFs), weekly time keeping, documentation of change orders, test reports, and other documents as required by the project deliverables.
  • Consults and coordinates as necessary to utilize suppliers with the capabilities to meet material and equipment needs.
  • Up to 10% travel may be required for training and visiting customer job sites.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related from an ABET accredited institution, preferred with a focus on power systems.
  • PE License Required.
  • 5+ years of design engineering experience on primary power distribution, P&C schemes, and/or electrical equipment.
  • Experience developing relay protective setpoints and settings files.
  • Working knowledge of NEC/NFPA 70, ANSI C57, ANSI C37, and NESC, and other applicable codes and standards in the design of substations and industrial power distribution.
  • 5 years of AutoCAD experience.
  • 5 years using power systems modeling software such as ETAP, SKM, and/or EasyPower.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to effectively discuss technical recommendations with customers.
  • Ability to work independently, accurately, and with high attention to detail.

Qualus offers a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, which may include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage, Retirement Savings Plans (including employer matching where applicable), Flexible Spending and/or Health Spending Accounts, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), Parental Leave, Paid Time Off, and Company Holidays. Benefits offerings may vary based on position, work location, and eligibility requirements. The compensation range for this position is provided in accordance with applicable laws and market practices. The final base salary offered may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, internal equity, performance, and business needs. Compensation ranges are subject to change at the Company's discretion and as permitted by applicable law.

Company Overview

Qualus is a leading pure-play power solutions firm and innovator at the forefront of power infrastructure transformation, with differentiated capabilities across grid modernization, resiliency, security, and sustainability. The firm partners with utilities, commercial, industrial, data center, and government clients, and renewable and energy storage developers, offering comprehensive solutions through boutique and integrated advisory, planning, engineering, digital solutions, program management, energy efficiency and specialized field services. Qualus also provides software and technology enabled services and develops breakthrough solutions for critical power industry challenges such as distributed and variable resource integration, emergency management, and secure data exchange. The firm has over 2,000 professionals, with offices throughout the U.S. and Canada.

raw.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a manager to lead its growing Donations Management Team. This role is accountable for the timely, accurate, secure, and donor-centered processing of charitable contributions across giving channels. This role establishes operational standards, supervises staff, owns policies and controls, collaborates with Advancement, Finance, IT, and other partners, and ensures donation records, receipting, fund coding, reconciliation, and donor service are completed with integrity.

The Manager serves as the primary escalation point for complex gift-processing issues and ensures the function remains aligned with organizational priorities, accepted nonprofit gift-administration practices, and audit-ready documentation. As World Relief continues to expand, it is vital that this role is someone who can also have a vision for the future of how we can provide world class donations management services.
100% Remote, bi-annual 4-day in-person event attendance expected

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees, including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values, including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.
  • Supervise Donations Management staff, including work planning, regular check-ins, goals, performance management, time and leave approvals, training, professional development, and required HRIS actions. Act as a spiritual leader who fosters a Christian work environment consistent with World Relief's values.
  • Set team priorities, service standards, staffing coverage, and quality expectations to ensure timely gift processing, tax receipting, donor notifications, and fundraiser alerts, including during peak campaigns and events.
  • Own the creation, approval, maintenance, and periodic review of Donations Management policies, controls, and standard operating procedures, including gift entry and coding, receipting, fund and event setup, refunds, recurring gifts, failed or returned transactions, anonymous gifts, gift credit, fundraiser notifications, documentation retention, and exception handling.
  • Oversee end-to-end processing and quality for checks, ACH and wires, credit and debit card gifts, recurring gifts, stock, cryptocurrency, workplace and payroll giving, donor-advised or third-party gifts, event platforms, and other current or emerging donation channels.
  • Ensure donor and gift records are consistently and accurately coded in Raiser's Edge and connected platforms, and ensure Fund IDs and related accounting codes align with general ledger requirements.
  • Direct recurring quality assurance, platform audits, exception review, and corrective-action follow-up; identify root causes and remove operational barriers that affect processing speed, accuracy, donor experience, or financial reporting.
  • Oversee donor service and escalations involving declined transactions, recurring gift changes, address and communication preference updates, receipts, refunds, returns, and other donation questions.
  • Oversee monthly reconciliations for online credit card, direct debit, and other giving streams; review pull-through submissions and fund summary reporting; partner with Finance to resolve variances and maintain audit-ready support.
  • Coordinate with the Raiser's Edge Database Administrator and other system owners on fiscal-year readiness, year-end tax statements, fund maintenance, access, integrations, and system or process changes affecting donations.
  • Build productive cross-functional relationships with Advancement, Finance, front-office/mail processing, Technology, fundraising teams, vendors, and distributed processing partners; clarify ownership, handoffs, service expectations, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare and manage the team budget, vendor and facility needs, and operational planning; visit the donation-processing facility at least annually or as business needs require.
  • Define and monitor meaningful operational measures such as turnaround time, accuracy, exceptions, unresolved items, and donor-service responsiveness; use trends to prioritize training and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of charitable gift administration and data stewardship practices, recommend improvements, and ensure appropriate confidentiality and safeguarding of donor and payment information.
  • Serve as the final operational decision-maker and escalation point for complex, unusual, or high-risk gifts within delegated authority, and elevate legal, tax, compliance, cybersecurity, reputational, or donor-intent concerns to the appropriate organizational owner.
  • Oversee and execute special projects as assigned

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Valid drivers license, access to reliable vehicle and ability to pass MVR standards
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience.
  • Strong understanding of gift coding, donor intent, receipting, reconciliations, data quality, internal controls, documentation, and confidentiality.
  • Previous people-management or formal supervisory experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Five or more years of relevant gift-processing, advancement-services, donor-services, or financial-operations experience, including two or more years leading staff or a significant operational function.
  • Experience supporting a large, multi-entity, multi-location, or international nonprofit organization.
  • Experience with charitable gifts such as stock, cryptocurrency, workplace giving, donor-advised funds, matching gifts, and event-based giving.
  • Experience with financial audits, payment-card controls, CRM integrations, process mapping, and continuous-improvement methods.
  • Relevant professional development or certification in fundraising operations, advancement services, nonprofit accounting, data management, or project management.
  • Working knowledge of Raiser's Edge NXT or a comparable fundraising CRM and familiarity with online fundraising and payment platforms.
  • Advanced ability to analyze operational issues, exercise sound judgment, manage risk, and translate findings into durable processes and controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, cross-functional leadership, change management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, including the ability to review reconciliations, reports, and large data sets.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and lead the team through peak-volume periods with accuracy and composure.
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

***

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is looking for an experienced Product Manager to help build a safe experience for the next generation of experiences for younger users while preserving a high-quality consumer experience. You will own ambiguous, zero-to-one product problems at the intersection of consumer product, safety, identity/age assurance, and global regulation. You will work closely with legal and cross-functional partners to determine what is truly required, frame clear options and tradeoffs, and ship scalable experiences that can adapt as laws and expectations evolve across markets.

Responsibilities

  • Own strategy, roadmap, requirements, launch, and measurable outcomes for Youth product initiatives.
  • Build and evolve age-assurance and third-party age-verification flows, including recovery/appeal experiences for users who are incorrectly classified.
  • Develop youth-specific product protections and controls, including age-gated content experiences, parental-control flows, and appropriate restrictions on product mechanics such as notifications, personalization, or chat where required.
  • Translate changing global regulations into objective product frameworks: clarify must-haves, deadlines, consequences, country exceptions, and viable product options with Legal and Policy.
  • Make principled tradeoffs between compliance, user experience, product value, technical complexity, and speed; escalate with clear evidence rather than treating legal interpretation as binary.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/ML, Design, Research, Safety, Policy, Legal, and adjacent Product teams to ship durable solutions at Reddit scale.
  • Define success metrics and launch guardrails, monitor false positives/negatives and user friction where relevant, and iterate based on data and qualitative feedback.
  • Communicate strategy, risk, decisions, and progress clearly to senior stakeholders, including Product leadership.

Must-have qualifications

  • Significant product management experience building and launching consumer products at large scale.
  • Demonstrated zero-to-one ownership: framing ambiguous problems, setting strategy, writing requirements, shipping, learning, and iterating.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to negotiate high-stakes tradeoffs with Legal, Engineering, Data, Safety/Policy, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and first-principles problem solving; can distinguish legal requirements from interpretations and convert ambiguity into decision frameworks.
  • Experience launching products across multiple markets or navigating meaningful market-specific requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including concise articulation of options, risk, rationale, and recommendations.

Nice-to-have qualifications

  • Direct Trust & Safety, youth safety, child/teen product, age assurance/verification, verified-account, or parental-control experience.
  • Experience with youth-focused or high-safety consumer products at high scaled environments.
  • Experience with content access controls, safety systems, notifications/personalization, messaging/chat protections, or other regulated consumer features.
  • Familiarity with ML/model-based classification and the product implications of false positives, false negatives, appeals, and verification fallbacks.

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

$217,000—$303,900 USD

raw.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage development for hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI), including congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI), the most common cause of persistent hypoglycemia in infants and children.

The Senior Manager, Scientific Communications & Medical Education will develop and manage Rezolute’s core scientific content and medical review activities for RZ358 across congenital and tumor HI. Key responsibilities include standard response document (SRD) development, in-house Medical Information, medical review in MLR/PRC, medical education grant management, Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) coordination, and MSL slide deck development. The Senior Manager will partner with MSLs, Medical Affairs Core Services, and cross-functional colleagues, and will report to the Director, Scientific Communications & Medical Education.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scientific Content Development

  • Develop and maintain standard response documents (SRDs), FAQs, and custom responses for RZ358.
  • Coordinate development and updates of the SCP with the Medical Communications vendor and cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and maintain MSL scientific slide decks aligned with the SCP and current clinical data.

    • Medical Information

    • Manage in-house Medical Information, providing accurate, balanced responses to unsolicited inquiries from HCPs, patients, and caregivers.
    • Partner with Medical Affairs Operations on Medical Information processes, vendor support, and inquiry tracking.
    • Identify inquiry trends and share insights with Medical Affairs.

      • MLR Medical Review

      • Serve as the Medical Affairs reviewer in MLR/PRC for promotional and non-promotional materials.
      • Ensure scientific accuracy, fair balance, and appropriate referencing, consistent with the SCP.

        • Medical Education Grants

        • Manage the medical education grant process, from request intake and review through approval, contracting, and reconciliation.
        • Ensure grants are independent, compliant with ACCME standards and company policy, and tracked against budget.

          • Compliance & Governance

          • Ensure activities adhere to Rezolute SOPs, regulatory standards, and industry codes of practice.
          • Contribute to SOPs and work instructions for SRDs, Medical Information, and grants.
            • Partner with pharmacovigilance on reporting of adverse events and product complaints received through Medical Information

Required Qualifications

    • PharmD, PhD, MD, or other advanced scientific degree.
    • Hands-on experience developing SRDs and Medical Information responses.
    • Experience serving as a Medical Affairs reviewer in MLR/PRC.
    • Working knowledge of medical education grant processes, ACCME standards, and applicable industry codes and transparency requirements.
    • Ability to translate complex scientific data into clear, accurate, and balanced content.
    • Strong project management and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and vendors.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
    • Willingness to travel domestically (up to approximately 20%).

      • Preferred Experience and Attributes

      • Minimum of 5 years of Medical Affairs experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, ideally in rare disease, endocrinology, or metabolic disease.
      • Experience supporting rare disease or pediatric product launches.
      • Experience with Veeva Vault PromoMats and Medical Information systems.
      • Experience working with Medical Communications agencies and Medical Information vendors.
      • High integrity, accountability, and commitment to Rezolute’s mission.

This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). raw.description:
SENIOR DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS

TH Experiential | Remote (US) | Full-time

TH Experiential is an experiential marketing and events agency with a 20-year history, building immersive brand worlds for global clients. We are in a growth stage, scaling the team and the business.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Operations to build and run how the agency operates day to day. This is a senior leadership role and a critical one for our next phase of growth.

You will build on the systems that make the agency run effectively, and you will get into the work to do it. You will work with each team, learn how the work moves, and build a standardized, repeatable way of operating that teams plug into, from intake and RFP through delivery and close-out. You lead through our team leads and program managers, set the standard, and hold the agency to it.

WHAT THIS ROLE OWNS

Operating framework and process

Own and evolve how TH runs across the full client and project lifecycle. Build the SOPs, workflows, and operating rhythms that make the work repeatable, and enforce them so projects are set up, scoped, staffed, and tracked the same way every time.

Project delivery

Own how projects are delivered across pitch, execution, close-out, and follow-up. Make sure every project is set up, run, and closed out the same way, so clients get clarity, consistency, and follow-through, and the team delivers on time and on margin.

Resourcing, capacity, and hours

Own hours forecasting and capacity planning across proposal, project, and support teams. Staff to the work in front of us, see what is coming, and plan ahead so we are always a step in front of the work.

Profitability and margin

Own project profitability, making sure every project is budgeted against real hours and costs, change orders are priced and signed before the work is done, and margins are tracked in real time. Find where we win and lose margin, and turn it into how we price and plan ahead.

Visibility and performance

Build the metrics, dashboards, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into project health, hours burn, margin, and operational risk, without having to go gather it. Surface risks early and drive corrective action.

Cadence and accountability

Own the weekly operating cadence across functions, feeding a clear picture of priorities, owners, and outcomes up to the leadership meeting. Keep the business running to its commitments, with gaps surfaced and resolved and the right issues raised for decision.

Developing our leads

Build the bench. Each lead works to clear expectations and a scorecard, with a regular rhythm of coaching that raises the standard of how they plan, own their areas, and bring forward solutions.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Each team follows one clear, repeatable way of working
  • Projects are set up right, delivered on time, and closed out on margin, every time
  • Leadership has real-time visibility into performance, risk, capacity, and profitability
  • Resourcing is planned ahead of the work
  • Our leads run their areas against clear scorecards and bring forward solutions
  • The business runs on the system, so it scales without depending on any one person

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 8-10+ years in operations leadership in a deadline-driven, client-service business. Agency, production, events, or similar.
  • You have built operating systems and gotten teams to follow them. You know the difference between designing a process and making it work.
  • You get into the detail. You are as comfortable in the work as you are above it, and you would rather build the machine than diagram it.
  • You hold the line on standards. You address gaps directly and raise what needs leadership attention.
  • Strong at capacity and resource planning, project profitability, and building KPIs and scorecards tied to efficiency, profitability, and scale
  • You have developed managers into leaders, and you lead through others rather than carrying the work yourself
  • You can hold a standard across a distributed team
  • Clear, direct communicator who leads with follow-through
  • A plus if you have run or adapted a formal operating system such as EOS, including meeting cadence, scorecards, and accountability structures

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

  • Base salary of $180,000 to $200,000, plus performance bonuses

- Health, dental, and life insurance

- 401(k) with company contribution

- Paid time off, sick days, and holidays

  • Remote work within the US, operating primarily on Eastern Time, with occasional travel as the work requires

TO APPLY

Send a resume and a short note on one operating system you built and got a team to actually follow. We would rather see one real example than a philosophy.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

Product

Description

AI Governance

Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.

AI Cloud Security

Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

AI Employee Guardrails

Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

AI Agent Security

Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.

AI Security Workbench

Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

A note on AI in our process: Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

This is a unique opportunity to become a part of our team during a milestone moment in our growth, benefiting from our deep cancer registry experience and employee-centric leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Apply specialized, clinical knowledge to hospital partners: categorize, code, summarize, interpret and calculate registry/case information from nuanced, patient medical records.
  • Ensure quality submission of all data in specified registries or measure data repositories, maintaining a high accuracy threshold.
  • Prioritize, organize, and meet tight deadlines for multiple concurrent tasks and team requests; uses tact and judgement to manage expectations, flag obstacles and propose solutions in a timely manner.
  • Navigate new technical systems: electronic medical records (EMR) and registry/case entry tools; use team resources to troubleshoot technical issues with systems and applications with a focus on solutions.
  • Contribute to team best practices, data dictionaries, abstraction guidelines, and other business rule documents; identifies process improvement opportunities to help streamline tasks and processes.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrates high standards for accuracy and attention to detail
  • Demonstrates technical savvy and strong desire to learn new systems and technology
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office (Microsoft Excel)
  • Thrives working independently and takes ownership of projects/patient records
  • Consistently and clearly communicates, adjusting style and tone as needed to effectively collaborate with hospital partners, peers, team leads and others
  • Demonstrates strong self-organizational and time management skills to concurrently manage multiple accounts, adjusting as needed to shifting timelines and priorities
  • Adapts to changes in hospital partner timelines, requirements, and project assignments
  • Maintains a high degree of responsibility in keeping PHI secure and confidential

raw.description:
We have an immediate opportunity for an IT Director to join a lean, high-impact technology team supporting more than 250 veterinary hospitals across the United States.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Technology, the IT Director will be responsible for leading day-to-day IT service delivery and helping execute key technology initiatives across Alliance Animal Health.

This is a highly hands-on technical leadership position. While the IT Director will provide leadership, direction, vendor oversight, and project management, this individual will also remain actively engaged in the technology environment, including troubleshooting complex issues, Microsoft 365 administration, escalations, infrastructure support, and direct engagement with practice teams.

The IT Director will have primary responsibility for the success of AAH’s newly established co-managed IT support model, working closely with our managed service provider, internal technology resources, hospital teams, Operations leadership, and other business stakeholders. This individual will be accountable for ensuring practices receive a consistent, responsive, and high-quality support experience while maintaining transparency, measurable service standards, and a strong customer-focused culture.

In addition to service delivery, the IT Director will have an active role in executing strategic technology initiatives across the organization. Strong project management skills are essential, as this position will lead and coordinate technology deployments, infrastructure improvements, practice onboarding initiatives, security programs, vendor implementations, and other enterprise IT projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with service leadership, project management, business judgment, and an exceptional customer-service mindset. Experience supporting veterinary, animal health, or multi-site healthcare environments is strongly preferred.

This is a fully remote position with periodic travel required for hospital visits, vendor engagements, project implementations, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

IT Support & Service Delivery

  • Own day-to-day IT support and service delivery across Alliance Animal Health’s national hospital network.
  • Provide leadership and direction for internal IT support resources and the co-managed IT service model.
  • Monitor ticket queues, escalations, service levels, response times, resolution performance, customer satisfaction, and recurring support trends.
  • Ensure practices receive consistent, timely, and customer-focused technology support.
  • Serve as a senior escalation resource and remain actively involved in troubleshooting complex technical issues when needed.
  • Establish and continuously improve support processes, escalation procedures, documentation standards, and service expectations.
  • Partner closely with hospital and Operations leadership to understand technology challenges and proactively address recurring issues.
  • Ensure technology support processes align with the operational needs of veterinary practices and minimize disruption to patient care and hospital operations.

Co-Managed IT & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day operational leader for AAH’s co-managed IT partnership.
  • Manage the relationship with the organization’s managed service provider and ensure the partnership operates as an extension of the AAH Technology team.
  • Define and maintain clear responsibilities between internal IT resources and external technology partners.
  • Hold vendors accountable to contractual commitments, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, and customer satisfaction objectives.
  • Lead recurring service reviews and operational governance meetings.
  • Review ticket trends, escalations, after-hours activity, recurring incidents, service performance, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate onboarding, knowledge transfer, process improvement, and service expansion activities.
  • Work collaboratively with technology vendors supporting specialized systems and equipment within veterinary hospitals.

Customer Experience & Practice Support

  • Serve as a senior advocate for AAH hospitals and ensure technology services remain focused on the needs of practice teams.
  • Build strong relationships with Practice Managers, Regional Directors, Regional Managers, Operations leadership, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Maintain regular communication with business partners regarding service performance, technology initiatives, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain a culture of accountability, responsiveness, transparency, and exceptional customer service.
  • Monitor Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and other experience metrics and develop improvement plans when performance falls below expectations.
  • Identify recurring issues across practices and work proactively with internal resources and external partners to address root causes.

Project & Program Management

  • Lead and coordinate key IT initiatives from planning through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and communication strategies.
  • Manage multiple concurrent technology projects across a nationally distributed organization.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders, MSP resources, vendors, Operations teams, and hospital leadership throughout project execution.
  • Lead or support initiatives involving:
    • New hospital onboarding and integration
    • Network standardization and infrastructure modernization
    • End-of-life hardware replacement programs
    • Microsoft 365 initiatives
    • Cybersecurity improvements
    • Endpoint management and standardization
    • Application implementations and migrations
    • Vendor transitions
    • Technology policy and process improvements
  • Communicate project status, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outcomes clearly to Technology and business leadership.
  • Create repeatable deployment playbooks and standards that allow technology initiatives to scale across the organization.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Own IT operational reporting and develop meaningful performance insights for Technology and executive leadership.
  • Establish appropriate service delivery KPIs and ensure accurate, consistent reporting.
  • Create and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual IT performance reports.
  • Monitor and report on:
    • Ticket volumes
    • First response times
    • Resolution times
    • Open and aging tickets
    • Escalation metrics
    • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
    • After-hours support activity
    • Hospital support trends
    • MSP and vendor performance
    • Recurring incidents and problem areas
  • Use service data and trend analysis to identify operational improvements and technology investment opportunities.
  • Provide concise, actionable technology updates to senior leadership.

Technical Leadership

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of the AAH technology environment and remain actively involved in technical operations.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for difficult or business-critical issues.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving endpoints, networking, Microsoft 365, authentication, cloud services, and hospital technology.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Systems Administrators and other internal technology resources.
  • Work closely with MSP engineering teams on advanced infrastructure, network, security, and cloud issues.
  • Support technology standards covering workstations, servers, firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure, remote access, endpoint security, and monitoring.
  • Partner with vendors supporting specialized veterinary equipment and software where coordination across multiple technology providers is required.
  • Maintain high-quality operational documentation, architecture information, asset visibility, standards, processes, and technology inventories.
  • Balance hands-on technical involvement with leadership responsibilities, escalating and delegating appropriately while maintaining ownership of outcomes.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year institution in Information Technology, Information Systems, Information Technology Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive professional experience in IT support, systems administration, infrastructure, service delivery, or technical operations.
  • 3+ years of IT leadership, service delivery leadership, or technology team management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading IT operations within a multi-site or distributed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing an MSP, technology service provider, or co-managed IT relationship.
  • Strong project management experience with responsibility for planning and delivering technology initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Strong technical knowledge of:
    • Microsoft 365
    • Entra ID
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Exchange Online
    • Microsoft Teams
    • SharePoint Online
    • Endpoint Management
    • Identity & Access Management
    • Conditional Access
    • Security and Compliance
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and technologies, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity.
  • Experience with IT service management, ticketing systems, remote monitoring and management platforms, endpoint management, and remote support technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage service metrics, reporting, SLAs, escalations, and customer satisfaction programs.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the technical depth to participate directly in complex escalations when required.
  • Exceptional customer service, relationship management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with practice teams, technical resources, vendors, Operations leaders, and senior executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, projects, vendors, and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to operate successfully within a fully remote organization and lead geographically distributed resources.
  • Ability to travel periodically as business and project requirements dictate.

Preferred

  • Veterinary or animal health technology experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting veterinary hospitals, animal health organizations, or other clinical environments.
  • Experience supporting 1,000+ users and/or 100+ geographically distributed locations.
  • Experience designing or operating a co-managed IT support model.
  • Experience leading technology integration for newly acquired or newly onboarded locations.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity operations, including EDR/MDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, security awareness, identity protection, and incident response.
  • Experience working with:
    • ConnectWise
    • NinjaOne
    • Auvik
    • Liongard
    • Huntress
    • Microsoft Defender
    • IT documentation and knowledge management platforms
  • Experience supporting specialized veterinary or healthcare technologies, including practice management systems, imaging systems, payment technologies, and clinical equipment.
  • Formal project management experience or certification such as PMP, CAPM, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • ITIL Foundation or other IT service management certification.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications.

This is a fully remote U.S.-based position with periodic travel required.

Alliance Animal Health offers a competitive compensation package including salary, bonus opportunity, health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact across a rapidly growing organization.

This role is intended for an experienced technology leader who is comfortable operating at both the strategic and technical levels. The successful candidate will be expected to lead IT service delivery and major technology initiatives while remaining close enough to the environment to actively participate in troubleshooting, technical decision-making, and practice support when needed.

Alliance Animal Health is a fast-growing, private equity-backed Veterinary Service Organization that operates as a majority owner and business partner to hundreds of veterinary practices across the US. Our goal is to make it easier for our practices at every step by providing world-class business solutions like talent acquisition, marketing, human resources, finance, and operations, so they can focus their energy on providing incredible care for animals. In fact, our Core Values are (quite literally) written with PETS in mind: Passion, Engagement, Trust, and Service.

We want our doctor partners to choose what’s best for their practice because they are the experts in medicine, while we customize the support, the co-ownership approach, and business solutions based on their goals. We pride ourselves on maintaining a culture of open communication and collaboration to deliver innovative solutions to advance today’s veterinary environment, without disrupting the medical autonomy and what makes each of our hospitals unique. Because at the end of the day, our central support team exists to serve our practices. So if you’re excited about using your talents to make an impact on the health and wellness of pets, we’d love to talk with you!

  • Perform page turns prior to all major project deliverables.
  • Work closely with subconsultants and department design managers.
  • Assist in developing client capture plans and pursuit plans, proposals, and other business development and client engagement activities.
  • Develop and enhance client relationships, serve as the primary company contact, and deliver quality projects on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of the client.
  • Administer relevant aspects of a formal quality program.
  • Marketing and business development support to include the identification of potential business opportunities.
  • Work with the leadership team to develop fees on complex projects.
  • Develop and maintain client relationships.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
  • At least 10 years of engineering experience, including a minimum of 4 years of experience as a PM.
  • PE, PMP, and/or equivalent license is preferred.
  • Experience in the healthcare and/or government contracting markets preferred but not required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to perform project management responsibilities, working independently and in coordination with other team members and Project Managers.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with multiple clients at varying stages of design/construction completion.

Miller-Remick does not provide visa sponsorship or support. Candidates are required to successfully complete a federal background check for security clearance.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $130,000 - $170,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including experience, qualifications, education, certifications and licensure.

raw.description:
Dans le cadre de la transformation numérique des services liés à l’eau en Wallonie, cette mission porte sur l’expertise SAP Field Service Management, avec un rôle central dans l’intégration des processus terrain au sein de l’écosystème SAP.

La personne recherchée intervient comme référent fonctionnel SAP FSM et contribue à l’optimisation des interventions, de la maintenance, de la gestion des ressources ainsi que de la planification des équipes techniques. Elle accompagne également les équipes métiers depuis l’expression du besoin jusqu’à la mise en production.

Mission principale

Vous prenez en charge la conception, le paramétrage, l’évolution et le support de la solution SAP FSM, en veillant à une intégration cohérente avec SAP PM, MM, FI, HR, SAP S/4HANA et les développements spécifiques. Vous jouez aussi un rôle actif dans la transmission des connaissances et l’accompagnement de profils plus juniors.

Responsabilités clés

  • Piloter la conception et les évolutions de la solution SAP FSM.
  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins métiers afin de définir les solutions fonctionnelles adaptées.
  • Assurer la responsabilité fonctionnelle sur les sujets liés à la planification, au dispatching, aux applications mobiles et à l’exécution des interventions terrain.
  • Optimiser les processus de planification et de dispatching des équipes terrain.
  • Paramétrer les activités, les équipes, les compétences, les SLA, les workflows et les règles métier dans SAP FSM.
  • Accompagner le déploiement et le support des applications mobiles destinées aux techniciens.
  • Garantir les intégrations entre SAP FSM Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, SAP PM, SAP MM, SAP FI, SAP HR et les applications périphériques.
  • Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles pour les développements ABAP, les APIs, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) et SAP BTP.
  • Assurer les tests, la qualité, la documentation ainsi que le support de niveau N2/N3.
  • Former les utilisateurs et accompagner la conduite du changement.
  • Encadrer les profils plus juniors au travers du tutorat, de peer reviews, de co-working, d’ateliers et de partages de bonnes pratiques.
  • Évaluer la progression technique des collaborateurs accompagnés et identifier les besoins de formation complémentaires.

📝 Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d’au moins 5 années d’expérience pratique sur SAP FSM.
  • Vous avez une expérience confirmée sur le Planning & Dispatching Board.
  • Vous maîtrisez les Mobile Applications SAP FSM.
  • Vous avez une pratique avancée de la configuration des activités, des équipes, des compétences et des SLA.
  • Vous connaissez les Smartforms, les workflows et les Business Rules.
  • Vous justifiez d’une expérience en intégration SAP FSM Cloud avec SAP S/4HANA.
  • Vous avez participé à plusieurs projets de déploiement ou de transformation autour de SAP FSM.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec SAP PM et disposez d’une bonne connaissance de SAP MM, SAP FI et SAP HR.
  • Vous pouvez intervenir sur des spécifications liées à l’ABAP, à l’intégration SAP et à SAP CPI.
  • Une expérience en environnement projet IT est attendue.
  • Vous travaillez de manière autonome, structurée et pragmatique.
  • Vous accordez de l’importance à la collaboration, au partage de connaissances, à l’amélioration continue et au sens du service public.
  • Vous pouvez travailler en français et en anglais.

Critères éliminatoires

  • Absence d’expérience significative sur SAP FSM.
  • Profil principalement orienté SAP PM sans maîtrise réelle de SAP FSM.
  • Absence d’expérience d’intégration entre SAP FSM et l’environnement SAP.
  • Absence d’expérience en support ou en déploiement de solutions terrain.

⚠️ Ce poste est proposé en tant que rôle freelance à temps partiel (60%).
